title: Data Engineer- Data Warehouse & Analytics
description:
**Job Title:**
Data Engineer – Data Warehouse & Analytics

**Location:**
Delhi (Work from Office)

**Experience:**
4–8 Years

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build, manage, and scale MARS Cosmetics' centralised data warehouse, creating a reliable foundation for analytics, business intelligence, and AI-driven decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain a scalable, centralised data warehouse.
* Integrate data from ERP, sales, distribution, e-commerce marketplaces, retail, and other business systems.
* Develop and automate ETL/ELT pipelines for reliable data ingestion and transformation.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and availability.
* Design efficient data models to support business reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics.
* Continuously optimise data infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost.

**Requirements:**

* 4–8 years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Warehousing.
* Strong proficiency in
  **SQL, Python, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling**
  .
* Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses such as
  **BigQuery, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or Redshift**
  .
* Experience with APIs, data integration, orchestration, and tools such as dbt or Airflow.
* Ability to independently architect, implement, and maintain production-grade data infrastructure.
* Experience integrating ERP, retail, or e-commerce data is preferred.

**Why Join MARS?**

An opportunity to build the core data infrastructure of one of India's fastest-growing beauty brands, with substantial ownership and direct business impact.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Center for Creative Leadership (CCL) is a US-based, world-renowned provider of leadership research, coaching, and consulting with over 50 years of experience, dedicated to advancing the understanding, practice, and development of leadership for the benefit of society worldwide. CCL has a Global Capability Center in India which hosts roles across CCL’s Global locations and has grown into a multi-function hub that increasingly owns and runs global processes end to end. Within CCL, the Global Technology Team (GTT) designs, builds, and supports the enterprise platforms, applications, and data assets that power CCL’s client programs, digital learning, and internal operations across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and is now investing in a modern, AI-ready data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.

Within GTT, the Senior Data Engineer is focused on designing, building, and running CCL’s enterprise data platform and data products, acting as the senior technical anchor for data engineering and a trusted partner to global business and technology stakeholders; the role leads the consolidation of a legacy Azure Synapse, Data Factory, and SSIS estate onto Microsoft Fabric, delivers governed and well-documented data products for Finance, Revenue Operations, analytics, and AI use cases, and holds overall responsibility for engineering standards, data quality, security, production reliability, and the mentoring of engineers as the GCC’s data capability scales.

**Principal Duties & Responsibilities:**

1. **Data platform engineering & modernization**
   — Designs, builds, and supports scalable production pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, notebooks, Lakehouse, Warehouse), Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Python on a Bronze-Silver-Gold (medallion) architecture, and leads the migration of Azure Synapse, Data Factory, and SSIS workloads to Fabric while retiring duplication and technical debt.
2. **Data modeling, analytics & AI enablement**
   — Designs dimensional and relational models, reusable datasets, and Power BI semantic models (including Direct Lake) with consistent, business-owned definitions, and prepares governed, well-documented data assets that can safely ground Copilot Studio agents and other AI solutions on CCL’s Microsoft estate.
3. **Finance & business data products**
   — Partners with Finance, Revenue Operations, and GCC process and data analysts to translate requirements into certified data products, including turning Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and project data into trusted reporting that reconciles what is sold, contracted, delivered, and invoiced.
4. **Data quality, governance & security**
   — Embeds automated testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting into every pipeline; applies access, privacy, and security controls (row- and object-level security, Key Vault-managed secrets) to protect sensitive client and participant data; and maintains metadata, lineage, business rules, and ownership using Microsoft Purview.
5. **DevOps, production support & operational excellence**
   — Uses Git, peer reviews, CI/CD, and Fabric deployment pipelines across development, test, and production; maintains runbooks, alerting, and support documentation; monitors and cost-optimizes Fabric capacity; and leads root-cause analysis so production issues, especially during finance-critical cycles such as month-end close, do not recur.
6. **Technical leadership & global collaboration**
   — Leads the technical design of complex data solutions as a senior individual contributor, establishes reusable engineering standards and design-review practices, mentors engineers and analysts in India, and communicates options, risks, and recommendations clearly to US and global stakeholders across time zones.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Technical Depth & Engineering Judgment**
  — Brings hands-on mastery of modern data engineering and makes sound, pragmatic choices on architecture, simplicity, cost, and maintainability; knows when a quick fix is acceptable and when a durable solution is required and takes ownership of the outcome.
* **End-to-End Ownership & Accountability**
  — Owns solutions from design through production support rather than handing off at deployment; holds self and others accountable to engineering standards, surfaces risks early, and builds trust by delivering what was committed.
* **Operational Discipline & Data Stewardship**
  — Treats data quality, security, governance, and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought; brings a calm, structured, root-cause approach to incidents and continuously hardens the platform.
* **Global Communication & Stakeholder Influence**
  — Explains complex technical concepts in clear business language, listens well, and influences senior global stakeholders (including pushing back when needed); builds strong working relationships across cultures, functions, and time zones.
* **Learning Agility & Multiplier Mindset**
  — Keeps pace with a fast-evolving Microsoft Fabric and AI landscape, experiments responsibly, and raises the capability of the people around them through mentoring, code reviews, and shared standards.

**Education and Experience:**

* **Education & Experience**
  — Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, along with 12-18 years of professional experience in data and technology, including 7+ years of hands-on data engineering and 3+ years designing solutions on Azure data platforms (Synapse, Data Factory, Databricks, or Fabric).
* **Global / MNC Exposure**
  — Sustained experience (typically 5+ years) in multinational environments such as a Global Capability Center, global product company, or international consulting practice, working directly with US or European stakeholders.
* **Technical Proficiency**
  — Strong command of SQL, Spark/PySpark, Python, Delta Lake, query optimization, data architecture, and data modeling; production experience with Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, deployment pipelines) and Power BI semantic models; working knowledge of Azure SQL, Data Lake Storage, Cosmos DB, Logic Apps, Key Vault, SSIS, and Git/Azure DevOps.
* **Certifications & Domain Exposure (Preferred)**
  — Microsoft Certified Fabric Data Engineer Associate or Fabric Analytics is a plus; In addition to this , Experience delivering data products on Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or Project Operations, enterprise governance with Microsoft Purview, and preparing data for generative AI and retrieval-based solutions is an added advantage.

**Other Requirements/Experience:**

* Willingness to work in India afternoon business hours with a regular 3-4-hour overlap with US Eastern Time for stakeholder meetings and production support.
* Occasional travel may be required, primarily to CCL’s India locations and, where needed, global CCL offices.
* *Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to present to senior global audiences, is essential.*

**Benefits:**

* Employer-paid insurance
* Flexi Benefit

*Paid time off and paid holidays*

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production.
  
  
This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
  
  
Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
  
  
This role is highly hands-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long-term architecture for AI-native development.
  
  
The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development**

* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**

* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**

* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**

* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**

* Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without

**Shape the Future of the Product**

* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

**You may be a fit if**

* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

**About the role**

We are looking for an AI Solutions Architect with 5–8 years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, or enterprise technology solutions who can design scalable, secure, and reliable AI-powered systems aligned with business requirements.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, product managers, engineering teams, and clients to understand complex requirements, evaluate AI technologies, define end-to-end solution architectures, and guide the implementation of production-ready AI solutions.

The role provides exposure to Generative AI, LLM applications, AI agents, RAG architectures, enterprise AI integrations, cloud infrastructure, system design, and AI governance.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Senior Solutions Architect

This is the person who will spearhead a data modernization program for VASCOR Logistics (www.vascorlogistics.com) and lead a data team from India.

Essential Skills and Experience

Level:
Senior executive hire.

Proven, hands-on experience is the primary requirement for this role. This role is for someone who has done this before, at comparable scale, and can show it.

Experience:

* 15+ years of professional experience, including 10+ years in senior data and cloud architecture roles.
* Has personally led, from design through cutover, the modernization of a large enterprise data estate (legacy SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and reporting) onto a modern cloud platform such as Microsoft Fabric or Azure.
* Deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, and medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture.
* 5+ years in applied machine learning or AI, including generative-AI and agent solutions shipped to production for real users.
* Has led engineering teams of 20 or more people, including hiring and developing senior engineers.
* Has presented technical strategy to executive leadership and boards.

Also required:

* Complete fluency in English, spoken and written.
* Holds a valid U.S. visa.

Scope and Authority

Leads:
the full data modernization program, from India.

Direct reports (proposed):
Lead Data Engineer, Data Governance Lead, and the senior Project Coordinator/Manager. All other roles report through them.

Decides:
platform design and technical standards, program priorities (including which AI use cases come first), sequencing of migration work, and build-versus-buy calls on tooling.

Escalates to:
the executive sponsor for budget changes, headcount changes, and cross-department priorities.

Location:
Gurugram first 6-month office based. After that in hybrid mode

Day-to-Day

* Set the technical direction for the new data platform, including how AI will run on it, and keep the design consistent across the team.
* Review and approve major designs from the Lead Data Engineer, ETL Engineers, and BI Developers before they are built.
* Own the program plan: migration phases, milestones, and sequencing in one plan.
* Run a weekly leadership meeting with the direct reports, and a monthly review of milestones, risks, and budget with the executive sponsor.
* Agree the order of migration with the business units, based on business value and data readiness, and agree with them which AI use cases come first.
* Work with the Data Governance Lead so that catalog, ownership, and access rules (and responsible-AI rules) are in place before data is released to the business.
* Represent the program to VASCOR leadership and the board; explain trade-offs in plain language.
* Coach the senior hires and unblock cross-team technical disputes.
* Lead hiring for the first waves: interview and approve every senior and lead hire.

Performance Measures

* Technical approach and program plan delivered in Month 1 and signed off by the executive sponsor.
* Program milestones hit on schedule across the wave plan (environment up by Months 2-3, bulk migration in Months 4-6, validation from Month 7).
* Governance foundation (catalog, data domains, stewards) in place on the planned timeline.
* First AI use cases delivered on plan: prototypes by Months 4-6, first AI feature by Months 7-9.
* Hiring plan adherence: roles filled per wave, and quality of hires (retention and ramp time).
* Design-related rework and incidents downstream (fewer is better).
* Platform performance against design targets once live (query latency, mirroring lag, uptime).
* Leadership satisfaction and team health: direct-report retention and engagement.

* Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize survey interfaces and design. Experience with Python or XML is a strong plus.

title: Director, Data Engineer (Python, Pyspark, MLOPs, LLMOPs, SQL, Databricks)
description:
**About this role:**
As a Director of Data Engineering in the Tech Market Economics team, you will serve as a core engineering leader for a rapidly growing capability, operating with the agility of a startup but with the backing and scale of Gartner. We are building Gartner's next generation of analytical platforms, transforming how we generate insights by moving from artisanal research to a continuous, AI-powered insight engine.
  
  
This is a strategic leadership role designed for a builder who wants to leave a lasting architectural footprint. You will not be inheriting a legacy maintenance project; you will be architecting the destination state for our data, analytics, and MLOps platforms. Partnering with cross-functional leaders, you will help evolve our operating model, establishing the engineering systems, telemetry, and automated evaluation frameworks necessary to scale complex AI workflows across the enterprise. If you are looking to step up, shape a modern engineering culture, and build combinatorial AI models that will influence the high-tech industry, this is your platform.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Architect the destination state for high-volume data pipelines that support both model training and complex, multi-prompt inference workflows at enterprise scale
* Design robust evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and automated quality gates to manage consistency, reliability, and variance in non-deterministic AI outputs
* Establish MLOps/LLMOps practices and system telemetry to monitor pipeline health, detect data and model drift, and ensure continuous performance in production
* Partner with Data Science, Product, and Research leaders to define technical roadmaps, moving prototype models into scalable, production-grade capabilities
* Architect solutions for data isolation, metadata management, and data classification across internal, external, and unstructured data sources
* Establish engineering standards, reusable code design principles, and CI/CD governance frameworks that accelerate engineering velocity while reducing technical debt
* Lead the modernization of production data platforms, identifying architectural bottlenecks, improving system resilience, and expanding end-to-end automation

**What you will need:**

* Experience: 9+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, advanced analytics, MLOps, and complex distributed system architecture.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Pipeline Architecture: Expertise in designing and optimizing robust enterprise pipelines, data workflows, and modern orchestration frameworks for complex AI/ML systems.
* AI/MLOps & Deployment: Proven track record of deploying, monitoring, and scaling AI models in production, including experience managing output consistency and implementing automated regression/evaluation suites.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience architecting scalable data systems within major cloud environments and modern enterprise data platforms.
* Programming & Tooling: Strong proficiency in Python, with deep experience using numerical processing, orchestration, and automated testing libraries to develop scalable enterprise solutions.
* Quality & Telemetry: Proven ability to build evaluation tooling, system monitoring dashboards, and alerting frameworks to catch performance degradation in production.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic technical builder who drives enterprise value by creating scalable systems, reusable assets, and durable architectures rather than just executing isolated tasks.
* An exceptional problem solver capable of taking loosely defined requirements or prototype models and translating them into actionable engineering architecture.
* Data-driven and analytically curious, with a passion for enterprise technology markets and the role AI plays in creating combinatorial insights.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing multiple priorities while effectively managing risk, technical debt, and architectural trade-offs.
* An effective communicator and technical leader capable of translating complex architectural concepts, system behaviors, and MLOps methodologies to diverse business, research, and technical audiences.

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
* Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy OPEX Executive who can identify operational inefficiencies, improve business processes and build technology-driven solutions that help our company operate more efficiently.

You will work closely with leadership and different departments to understand how work gets done, identify where time and resources are being wasted, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation and internal tools.

This could involve evaluating a department's workflow to reduce unnecessary manual work, building an internal training academy using existing SOPs, developing dashboards to track performance, or automating repetitive reporting tasks.

We are looking for someone who can take a business problem statement, determine the best way to solve it, and turn it into a working solution quickly. For smaller projects, the expectation is to develop a functional first version within 24–48 hours where the scope permits, then test and improve it based on feedback.

**This is a hands-on implementation role. You will be expected to identify problems, build solutions, implement improvements and measure the results — not simply prepare reports or make recommendations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Process Improvement & Time Efficiency**

* Evaluate existing company processes across departments to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated work and unnecessary manual tasks.
* Conduct time-and-motion analysis to understand how long tasks take, where time is being lost and how workflows can be improved.
* Map existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce steps and improve turnaround times.
* Work with department heads and team members to understand operational challenges and identify practical improvements.
* Develop and implement solutions that reduce administrative workload, repetitive tasks and dependency on manual follow-ups.
* Measure the impact of improvements by tracking time saved, productivity, error reduction and process turnaround times.
* Continuously review existing workflows and recommend improvements as the business grows.

**2. AI-Powered Internal Tools & Systems**

* Translate business problem statements into functional internal tools, platforms and systems.
* Build tools such as internal training academies, knowledge hubs, SOP libraries, onboarding portals and operational management systems.
* Use existing company documentation, SOPs and resources to create structured, searchable and user-friendly internal platforms.
* Use AI tools to accelerate development and turn ideas into functional prototypes quickly.
* Test solutions with end users, incorporate feedback and improve usability.
* Take ownership of tools from initial concept through implementation, maintenance and ongoing improvement.

**3. Internal Dashboards & Backend Development**

* Build and maintain internal dashboards for departmental KPIs, business performance, team productivity and operational tracking.
* Develop the underlying data structures, workflows, logic and integrations required to make dashboards functional.
* Connect relevant data sources and internal tools to reduce manual reporting and improve data visibility.
* Update dashboards and systems as business requirements evolve.
* Ensure tools are accurate, reliable, easy to use and appropriately access-controlled.

**4. AI, Prompt Engineering & Rapid Prototyping**

* Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and AI-assisted coding platforms to build, troubleshoot and improve internal solutions.
* Write effective prompts and structured instructions to develop functional tools and automate processes.
* Identify the most appropriate combination of AI tools, no-code platforms, integrations and coding for each problem.
* Experiment with new technologies to find faster and more effective ways of working.
* Validate AI-generated outputs, troubleshoot errors and ensure solutions work as intended.
* Stay informed about emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply them across the business.

**5. Workflow Automation & System Integration**

* Identify repetitive tasks and manual workflows that can be automated.
* Build automations connecting internal systems, forms, databases, dashboards and reporting tools.
* Reduce manual data entry, duplicated work and unnecessary communication between departments.
* Improve information flow, accountability and visibility across teams.
* Document automated workflows and maintain clear instructions for ongoing use.

**6. System Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve existing dashboards, internal tools, automations and workflows.
* Respond to changing business requirements and implement updates promptly.
* Troubleshoot issues, resolve errors and maintain data accuracy.
* Update SOPs and process documentation whenever workflows change.
* Monitor whether implemented solutions are delivering the intended results.
* Take ownership of the systems you build instead of relying on external developers for routine changes.

**Skills & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in operations, process improvement, business systems, automation, internal tool development or a related field.
* Demonstrable experience building functional dashboards, internal tools, web applications or automated workflows.
* Practical experience using AI tools to develop and improve digital solutions.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured solutions and working prototypes.
* Understanding of workflow mapping, process optimisation, root-cause analysis or time-and-motion analysis.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding, no-code/low-code development or frontend development.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, data structures and system integrations.
* Experience with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, n8n, Make or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and work independently.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different departments.
* Understanding of data security, access permissions, testing and system reliability.
* **Travel:**
  Must be comfortable travelling between Delhi and Gurgaon as required.

Candidates do not need expertise in every tool listed. We value practical building ability, analytical thinking, initiative and speed of execution over familiarity with a specific technology stack.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You are someone who:

* **Thinks in solutions:**
  You can take a business problem and determine how best to solve it.
* **Identifies inefficiencies:**
  You naturally question why a process exists, how long it takes and whether it could be done better.
* **Builds quickly:**
  You can develop a functional first version within hours or days rather than spending weeks planning.
* **Uses AI effectively:**
  You know how to prompt, build, debug and refine solutions using AI tools.
* **Understands systems:**
  You can work with dashboards, data, workflows, integrations and internal processes.
* **Takes ownership:**
  You implement solutions rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Measures outcomes:**
  You look for tangible improvements in time, effort, accuracy and productivity.
* **Works independently:**
  You need the desired outcome explained, not every individual step prescribed.
* **Adapts quickly:**
  You are comfortable with changing priorities and evolving business requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Evaluate processes across multiple departments and identify high-impact improvement opportunities.
* Implement practical solutions that reduce manual work, wasted time and operational bottlenecks.
* Build and deploy internal dashboards and tools from business problem statements.
* Develop and improve internal platforms using existing company SOPs and resources.
* Automate repetitive workflows and reduce dependency on manual reporting.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in time efficiency, turnaround times and team productivity.
* Establish a continuous improvement process for reviewing, optimising and documenting business operations.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and examples of dashboards, internal tools, automations or process improvements you have worked on.

As part of your application, briefly explain:

1. What business or operational problem were you solving?
2. What did you personally build or improve?
3. Which tools and technologies did you use?
4. How long did it take to implement?
5. What measurable results did the solution achieve?

Practical demonstrations and working examples will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

title: Director, People Data and Reporting
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Metrics & Reporting**

* Own the global people metrics catalogue: definitions, calculation logic, and ownership for headcount, attrition, hiring, mobility, diversity, and related measures.
* Lead the move from custom report requests to self-serve reporting, rationalising legacy reports into a small set of governed master reports with role-based access.
* Own management and executive reporting for People & Culture leadership, the Senior Leadership Team, and Finance, on a consistent monthly and quarterly cadence.
* Define the reporting dimensions that must hold across every layer: organisation structure, job classification, location, supervisory hierarchy, and grade.
* Ensure historical trends survive organisation restructures and employee ID changes.
* Put export guardrails and access controls in place, reducing reliance on uncontrolled data extracts.

**Data Governance & Quality**

* Establish and run the people data governance framework: decision rights, data ownership, stewardship, and a clear RACI across People Analytics, HR process owners, IT, and Finance.
* Own the semantic layer standards and data dictionary for people data.
* Lead monthly headcount reconciliation with Finance and resolve differences between HR and Finance figures at source.
* Build a data quality programme with measurable rules, scorecards, root-cause fixes, and accountable owners in the HR process teams.
* Work with Data Protection and Legal on GDPR and local privacy requirements, including access, retention, and cross-border data use.
* Maintain documentation, lineage, and change control for reports, metrics, and data pipelines.

**Leadership and partnership**

* Lead and develop a distributed team across both functions, setting clear priorities and standards.
* Act as the senior counterpart to HRIS, IT data engineering, and Finance on reporting and data decisions, including HRIS programme milestones.
* Prioritise demand transparently and say no to requests that duplicate governed reporting.
* Partner with the Analytics and AI teams so advanced analytics builds on governed, reusable data rather than one-off extracts.
* Build a regular interlock with business and functional leaders to understand their decisions, agree the measures that matter, and turn governed reporting into insight.

**What You'll Bring**

* [15+] years in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce data, or enterprise data management, with at least [5] years leading teams.
* Global ownership of HR or workforce reporting in a large multinational, ideally at 50,000+ employees.
* Proven delivery of a data governance framework: decision rights, stewardship, data dictionaries, and data quality measurement.
* Hands-on understanding of HR data models, including organisation hierarchies, effective dating, and handling restructures without breaking trends.
* Strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors reporting, plus a data lake or warehouse and a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
* Experience working with SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and Snowflake.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including data engineering, lakehouse, and semantic models.
* Proven ability to work through disparate data sets from HR, Finance, and other enterprise systems, and bring them into a single, governed semantic layer.
* Strong business interlock: experience partnering with business and functional leaders to frame questions, agree measures, and turn reporting into insight that drives decisions.
* Experience reconciling workforce data with Finance, including headcount and cost definitions.
* Track record of rationalising a report estate and moving users to self-serve.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and data protection requirements for employee data.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders in HR, IT, and Finance, and to hold a line on standards.
* Experience leading distributed teams across regions and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, information systems, or business discipline.

Nice to have
  
  

* Master's degree in analytics, information management, or an MBA.
* Data governance certification such as DAMA CDMP, or familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK.
* Experience with an HRIS migration or consolidation, including post-merger integration.
* Experience with data catalogue or lineage tools such as Collibra, Alation, or Microsoft Purview.
* SQL skills and familiarity with semantic modelling in Power BI or similar.
* Experience defining metrics to external standards such as ISO 30414.
* Experience working with works councils on employee data use.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

title: Internship, AI Software Engineering (Delhi NCR)
description:
**Company Description**
Atomic Computing is an AWS Advanced Tier Partner specializing in enterprise cloud, application modernization, and AI engineering, including production-grade generative and agentic AI systems. The company has achieved multiple AWS certifications and deployed over 300 enterprise workloads across sectors such as financial services, healthcare, government, and technology. Atomic emphasizes security-first cloud architecture, FinOps-focused cost optimization, and audit-ready compliance aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR. With offices in the United States, Germany, and the United Arab Emirates, Atomic helps mid-to-large enterprises turn cloud and AI investments into measurable business outcomes. Potential team members can learn more at atomiccomputing.com.

**Role Description**
This is a remote, contract Internship role in Cloud & AI Software Engineering based in the Delhi NCR region. Interns will assist in designing, developing, and testing cloud-native software components under the guidance of senior engineers. Day-to-day responsibilities may include writing and reviewing code, working with databases, configuring Linux-based environments, and supporting MERN Stack-based services. Interns will collaborate with cross-functional teams to document technical work, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to proof-of-concept projects involving cloud and AI solutions. The role offers exposure to modern engineering practices, cloud infrastructure, and real-world enterprise workloads.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Software Development and Programming, with experience in at least one high-level language.
* Working knowledge of Databases, including basic schema design, querying, and data handling.
* Comfortable using Linux or similar operating systems for development, deployment, and troubleshooting tasks.
* Familiarity with MERN Stack for building and maintaining backend services or applications.
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts (preferably AWS), microservices, and APIs is beneficial.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Ability to learn quickly, work independently in a remote setting, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a structured approach to problem-solving and documentation.

**About The Role.**
The Data Quality and Governance Engineer plays a critical role in strengthening McCain’s enterprise data foundation by ensuring data is accurate, trusted, secure, and well-governed. As part of McCain’s digital transformation journey, this role will lead data quality and governance initiatives, implement metadata management and cataloging practices, and support the deployment of governance tools and policies. By partnering with business and technical stakeholders, the Data Quality and Governance Engineer helps enable reliable, compliant, and business-ready data that supports operational excellence and strategic decision-making.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Establish and maintain enterprise data quality frameworks, standards, and controls focused on accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity.
* Perform data profiling, validation, monitoring, and cleansing activities using data quality and governance tools.
* Leverage AI-enabled capabilities, including anomaly detection and metadata classification, to improve data governance and quality processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate remediation efforts for identified data quality issues.
* Define and monitor data quality metrics, KPIs, validation rules, and compliance requirements in partnership with business and technical stakeholders.
* Document business rules, validation logic, data definitions, and exception management processes for critical data assets.
* Manage and maintain enterprise metadata, data catalog, and data lineage documentation across platforms and domains.
* Collaborate with data engineers, architects, data stewards, and business teams to capture data flows, transformations, and lineage.
* Support the implementation, optimization, and adoption of data governance, reference data, and data quality tools.
* Deliver governance training, onboarding, reporting, and documentation to drive awareness, compliance, and adoption of data governance practices.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in data governance, data management, data engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of metadata standards, data lineage, data classification, and governance best practices.
* Proficiency in SQL and/or Python for data profiling, validation, analysis, and troubleshooting.
* Experience collaborating with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards, IT teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Hands-on experience with data governance and data quality platforms such as Ataccama, Syniti, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Informatica, or Alation.
* Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar technologies.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and stakeholders.
* Experience developing metrics and KPIs to measure governance effectiveness, business impact, and compliance.
* Familiarity with data management and governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, or similar.

* Preferred: Exposure to AI governance, responsible AI principles, and data considerations for AI/ML solutions.
* Preferred: AIGP certification.

* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: AI Manager
description:
**AI Manager**

**Location**

Gurugram (Udyog Vihar Phase III), on-site; occasional travel to project sites

**Reports To -**
Head of IT

**Experience -**
7 to 10 years

**Employment Type -**
Full-time, permanent

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Most companies are still debating AI. We have decided to build it into how we engineer, bid, deliver and operate. WOG is looking for its first AI Manager to lead AI transformation and implementation across the company - deciding where AI goes to work, building it, and making sure it is adopted safely.

You will not be one voice in a large digital team. You will own the AI agenda end to end, with direct access to the CEO and leadership, and real engineering problems to solve - in water, wastewater and green energy.

**ABOUT WOG**

WOG Technologies is an IP-led engineering and technology company in water, wastewater and green energy, with 190+ projects delivered across 20+ countries and 350+ engineers. The group includes Bell Cooling Towers and the WOG Green Energy businesses - Green Coal, Carbon Loops, BESS, CBG and Carbon Credits. We are building a patent portfolio and a technology-first culture, and AI is central to that.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Set the AI agenda**

* Map how work flows across the business - proposals and bids, design and engineering, procurement, project delivery, plant operations and support functions - and find where AI saves the most time and money.
* Build and own a 12-month AI roadmap with a business case for every use case, and report the value delivered.

**Get the data ready**

* Organise the data AI depends on - document repositories, master data, and HR, finance and project records - so that AI answers are accurate and traceable.
* Set data ownership and quality standards with each function, starting with the data behind the first use cases.

**Build and ship AI solutions**

* Deploy enterprise AI tools - LLM assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation - and integrate them with our HRMS, ERP, Microsoft 365 and document systems.
* Design and deploy agentic AI: agents that carry out multi-step work across our systems, such as preparing tender responses, reconciling vendor quotes or compiling management reports, with people approving the key decisions.
* Automate high-effort work such as tender review, BOQ and estimation support, document control and management reporting.
* Explore AI for plant performance: predictive maintenance, process optimisation and remote monitoring.

**Make AI safe to use**

* Move WOG from restricted AI use to governed adoption: approved enterprise tools, a clear AI usage policy, and no company data in unapproved platforms.
* Configure data loss prevention (Microsoft Purview DLP) and sensitivity labels so AI tools see only what they should.
* Control what AI agents can access and do: least-privilege permissions, human approval for consequential actions, and full logging.
* Assess AI vendors for security, privacy and contractual risk; keep AI use compliant with the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000.

**Bring people along**

* Train employees and leaders to use AI well, and build a library of approved prompts, templates and agents.
* Work hand in hand with the IT team, which runs infrastructure and cyber security.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer applications or a related discipline.
* 7 to 10 years in technology, digital transformation or engineering roles, including hands-on generative AI work since late 2022.
* AI work you can show us: at least two AI solutions taken to production in an organisation, with measurable results.
* Working knowledge of Python, APIs and low-code automation, and of data protection in Microsoft 365 (DLP, sensitivity labels, access controls).
* An AI certification or programme from a reputed institute (IIT, IISc, IIM, ISB or a global equivalent) or a recognised vendor (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS).
* Interest in engineering businesses, with understanding of the water and wastewater industry or a willingness to learn it quickly.

**Good to have**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
* A cyber security certification - CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-401 / SC-300.
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (multi-step agents with tool access) in production.
* Postgraduate degree in AI, Machine Learning or Data Science.
* Experience in engineering, infrastructure, utilities, energy or manufacturing companies.

If you meet most of the must-haves and have shipped real AI work, apply. We hire for proven ability, not a perfect checklist.

**WHY WOG**

* Build it, don't maintain it: you are the first person in this role and shape how a whole company works.
* Direct line to leadership: your roadmap goes to the CEO, not through layers.
* Real-world impact and a broad canvas: water, wastewater and five green energy businesses.

title: Global M&C Data Architect Director & Chapter Lead – MarTech
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The MarTech Data Architect & Data Engineering Chapter Lead for Marketing & Communications is a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering excellence, architectural integrity, and continuous evolution of BCG's marketing data foundation and connected platforms. Sitting within the MarTech Engineering team, this person leads the data engineering chapter that serves BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data functions owning the technical standards, pipeline architecture, and data platform capability that underpins the full marketing analytics and data ecosystem, from CRM data operations and audience segmentation through to Tableau dashboard delivery, channel performance intelligence, and AI-assisted insight generation.
  
  
A core part of this ownership is the identity resolution model the framework that matches and unifies client and contact records across marketing data and CRM systems into a single trusted profile. The Chapter Lead designs, manages, and continually refines this model, and partners closely with BCG's core data architect, client, marketing, CRM and engineering teams and data functions to maintain a shared, consistent definition of identity across systems.
  
  
This role also carries direct responsibility for aligning the marketing data layer with BCG's wider enterprise data approach. The Chapter Lead partners with enterprise data governance and architecture teams to ensure marketing's data standards, access controls, lineage, and quality practices are built to firm-wide policy rather than developed in isolation representing marketing's needs in enterprise governance forums while bringing enterprise requirements back into the marketing data roadmap.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of technical leadership and marketing analytics product delivery. The Chapter Lead is not only the most senior data engineering voice they are an active partner to the product owners, analysts, and insight leaders whose work depends on the reliability, quality, and sophistication of the data infrastructure this person builds and leads. They lead and develop the data engineering team, set the data engineering direction in line witht the overall MarTech strategy and standards, establish the data standards, and ensure that BCG's marketing data platforms are capable of supporting not just today's analytics needs but the agentic intelligent data environment the marketing organization is building toward.
  
  
Chapter Leadership & Data Engineering Development
  
  

* Lead the data engineering chapter serving BCG's Global Marketing & Communications team setting technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and creating an environment where engineers across squads are developing their skills, doing their best work, and growing their careers
* Provide architectural oversight and hands-on review of engineering work across the chapter code quality, architectural consistency, pipeline reliability, and data modeling standards are upheld across all squads the chapter serves
* Actively mentor and develop chapter engineers conducting regular technical reviews, providing structured feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and building the collective engineering capability that allows the chapter to take on increasingly sophisticated data and AI challenges over time
* Partner with squad product owners to ensure engineering capacity, technical priorities, and sprint commitments are aligned with the analytical products and insight capabilities the marketing organization depends on
* Contribute to hiring decisions, team structure, and data engineering development helping build a chapter that is technically excellent, well-motivated, and capable of sustaining the marketing analytics function's growing ambitions

Data Pipeline Architecture & Engineering
  
  

* Design, document, and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that feed the marketing analytics data models powering BCG's dashboard suite, channel insight products, audience intelligence, and CRM data operations built on Snowflake, dbt, and Apache Airflow as the core platform stack
* Build monitoring and alerting for match-rate quality, pipeline failures, and unexpected shifts in merge/split volume Establish a lineage trail so any resolved identity can be traced back to its contributing source records and the logic that merged them
* Build processes to handle un-merging (splitting incorrectly merged records) as well as merging
* Implement data standardization logic (name normalization, address formatting, email canonicalization) as a pre-processing layer ahead of matching
* Integrate data from across BCG's marketing technology ecosystem into the marketing data environment in a structured, governed, and scalable way that supports both current reporting needs and future analytical capability
* Apply SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks rigorously across pipeline development ensuring that data arriving in the marketing master dataset is accurate, complete, historically traceable, and fit for the analytical and insight purposes it is intended to serve
* Evaluate and implement new technical solutions, data engineering patterns, and platform capabilities that improve the reliability, performance, and sophistication of BCG's marketing data infrastructure contributing MVPs and proofs of concept that demonstrate feasibility before committing to full implementation

Data Quality, Governance & Security
  
  

* Own the data quality and governance standards for BCG's marketing data engineering environment implementing the monitoring, validation, and alerting frameworks that catch data quality issues before they surface as errors in stakeholder-facing dashboards or analytical outputs
* Implement data performance and data security policies that align with BCG's governance objectives, regulatory requirements, and privacy obligations working in close partnership with enterprise data governance, IT security, and legal colleagues to ensure the marketing data environment meets the firm's standards across all dimensions
* Maintain clear, accessible documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and engineering decisions building institutional knowledge that reduces key-person dependency and supports the chapter's resilience as it grows

AI & Identity Resolution Architecture
  
  

* Design the end-to-end identity resolution architecture spanning CRM, marketing automation, web/behavioral data, campaign platforms, and third-party data sources
* Define the matching strategy: deterministic rules (exact matches on email, phone, CRM ID) vs. probabilistic matching (fuzzy name/address matching, behavioral signals), and when each applies
* Design the "golden record" / unified profile structure what fields it contains, how conflicting values are resolved, and which source system wins for each data type
* Build a confidence-scoring framework so matches are tiered (auto-merge, flag-for-review, reject) rather than treated as all-or-nothing
* Define the survivorship rules most recent, most complete, most trusted source that determine what data persists into the unified profile when records merge
* Design for scale and extensibility so new data sources (new martech tools, new regions, new business lines) can be onboarded without re-architecting the core model

Technical Monitoring & Incident Management
  
  

* Actively monitor the health, performance, and reliability of BCG's marketing data pipelines and Snowflake environment — establishing the observability frameworks, alerting standards, and incident response protocols that minimize disruption to the analytical products and insight outputs the marketing organization depends on
* Lead the triage and resolution of critical technical incidents with urgency, clarity, and sound engineering judgment — communicating clearly with product owners and stakeholders throughout, and ensuring that root cause analysis and remediation are completed systematically rather than reactively
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks across the data engineering environment — conducting regular performance reviews and implementing optimization improvements that keep the platform scalable and responsive as data volumes, analytical complexity, and user demand grow

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Build strong working relationships with external stakeholders across BCG's global data and technology organization ensuring that marketing's data engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that dependencies are managed proactively
* Partner with IT architecture and platform teams on shared infrastructure decisions — including AWS cloud services, Azure Active Directory integration, and CI/CD pipeline tooling — ensuring marketing's engineering choices are compatible with BCG's broader technology environment
* Engage with product portfolio management and cross-functional data product teams across finance, HR, legal, and other BCG functions — contributing a marketing analytics perspective to firm-wide data platform conversations and maintaining awareness of cross-functional data and security trends that affect the marketing data environment

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Leading a chapter of data engineers with technical authority and genuine investment in their development — you set a high bar, model it yourself, and bring people along rather than simply holding them to it
* Designing data pipeline architectures and Snowflake data models that are not just technically correct but genuinely built for the analytical consumption patterns of a sophisticated marketing analytics function — you think about the downstream insight need as much as the upstream engineering requirement
* Writing advanced SQL and well-structured dbt models that your colleagues can read, understand, maintain, and build on — you treat code quality and documentation as professional obligations, not optional extras
* Navigating the intersection of data engineering and marketing analytics with enough domain fluency to engage credibly with product owners, analysts, and insight leaders — you understand what they are trying to build and why, and you engineer solutions that serve those needs rather than just satisfying technical requirements
* Bringing a current and practical perspective on AI and its implications for data engineering — you are not evangelizing AI for its own sake, but you have a well-formed view of where intelligent automation, Snowflake Cortex, and LLM integration create genuine engineering opportunity in a marketing analytics context
* Staying calm and effective in critical incidents — you triage with sound judgment, communicate clearly under pressure, and resolve issues systematically rather than reactively
* Collaborating with product owners and Agile teams in a way that adds engineering value to product decisions — you show up to sprint ceremonies prepared, you flag technical risk early, and you help the squad make better product decisions by making the engineering trade-offs visible and understandable

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 13+ years of data engineering experience with a strong focus on data warehouse architecture, pipeline development, and data modeling, including at least 2–3 years in a chapter lead, technical lead, or senior engineering leadership role
* Demonstrably advanced SQL proficiency and deep hands-on experience with Snowflake — including data modeling, performance optimization, security configuration, and consumption layer design for analytical workloads
* Expert-level proficiency with dbt for data transformation and data model development, and strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for pipeline orchestration and job scheduling
* Solid experience applying SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks in production data engineering environments — you have built these patterns, maintained them, and debugged them when they break
* Demonstrated ability to write clean, well-documented, version-controlled code — you use GitHub or Bitbucket as a professional standard, not an afterthought
* Experience integrating data from complex, multi-platform marketing or enterprise technology ecosystems — familiarity with platforms such as Dynamics CRM, Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, or equivalent marketing technology is a meaningful advantage
* Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to data engineering — including intelligent pipeline orchestration, AI-assisted data quality, and the evolving role of Snowflake Cortex or equivalent capabilities in analytics environments
* Strong Python scripting skills for pipeline development, automation, and data engineering tooling; experience with PowerShell or equivalent a plus
* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS preferred, Azure and GCP also valued — and familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tooling and version control workflows in a production data engineering environment
* Experience working in Agile and scrum-based delivery environments — including active participation in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and cross-functional squad collaboration with product owners, architects, and data SMEs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to present architecture decisions, engineering trade-offs, and technical recommendations to non-technical product owners and marketing stakeholders clearly and confidently
* Experience with JIRA and Confluence for delivery management and technical documentation
* Familiarity with other data platforms including Oracle, SQL Server, or MDM systems is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role operates within BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data hub functions as the senior technical leader of the data engineering chapter that serves it. Your most important day-to-day working relationships are with the engineers in your chapter — the people whose technical growth, work quality, and professional development you are directly accountable for — and with the product owners across the marketing analytics and data hub squads whose roadmaps depend on the reliability and capability of the engineering infrastructure your chapter builds and maintains.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will partner closely with the Director of Marketing Analytics and the Director of Data Hub who run the squads who access, monitor, and deliver insights and data driven insights for the global marketing organization. You will also collaborate with the CRM data operations and CRM engineering leads — ensuring that the data quality and governance standards that apply at the platform level are reflected in the CRM data environment that feeds the broader marketing analytics ecosystem.
  
  
Beyond the marketing analytics and data hub functions, you will be expected to engage regularly with BCG's enterprise data organization to ensure marketing's engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that shared infrastructure decisions reflect marketing's needs. You will also work with IT architecture, cloud platform, and security colleagues on the infrastructure and governance dimensions of the marketing data environment.
  
  
At the most senior level, you will engage with the Director of Marketing Analytics & Data and Director of Data Hub as a peer and strategic partner — contributing the engineering perspective that shapes how the function's data platform capability evolves, how AI and emerging technology are incorporated into the chapter's roadmap, and how BCG's marketing analytics and data infrastructure is positioned to support the organization's most ambitious data and insight ambitions.
  
  
This is a role for a data engineering leader who finds genuine satisfaction in the combination of deep technical craft and organizational impact — who wants to build something that is not just technically excellent but genuinely indispensable to how a world-class marketing organization understands and acts on its data.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

title: Technical Consultant - Integration
description:
