* Hosting or infrastructure support background

title: SCT-Tech Enablment-Aera Technology-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**CNS (300)**
**-**
**Senior Consultant - Aera Technology**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.

* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.

title: CAT Modeling (for one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates)-
description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.
  
  
Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The Role**
An exciting opportunity for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to join a leading Exposure Management team at one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates. The successful candidate will be delivering cutting edge analytics to stakeholders across the business for the D&F Property class, which has seen significant growth over the last 12 months. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate looking to have a material impact at a top Lloyds’ syndicate and global (re)insurer.
  
  
As an analyst, you will have a real ability to meaningfully influence the risk selection process. The successful candidate will look to work collaboratively with various internal stakeholders to ensure timely modelling analytics to support risk pricing and wider Catastrophe Management goals.
  
  
**Skill mix: Account Modeling + Data Cleansing**
**CAT Modelers/ Sr. CAT Modelers:**
**Responsibilities:**

* Confident and timely delivery of analytics and the ability to explain how these analytics can help drive risk selection.
* Use RMS and various other tools to deliver market leading analysis both on individual account and portfolio basis.
* Work closely with the Natural Catastrophe Management team, across different regions, to ensure close communication across the team, consistent application of view of risk and contribute to cross-region analytics.
* Create a narrative based on the modelling data and other sources to effectively provide a valuable summary of a certain risk and give advice to Underwriters on the strengths and weaknesses of both the data and the model’s ability to provide meaningful results. This includes communicating the concept of uncertainty.
* Communicate risk metrics to key stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the Analytics and Reporting team to ensure timely delivery of data required for internal and external reporting.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Experience in a Cat Modelling role – RMS experience is highly desirable and D&F Property class experience is advantageous.
* Highly numerate and logical – strong mathematical/statistical knowledge is advantageous.
* Excellent business communication skills – ability to influence, negotiate, and listen.
* Ability to manipulate large data sets with strong Excel and SQL skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Power BI for analytics is desirable.
* Intermediate/Advanced Experience with MS SQL is a strong advantage. Ability to build/design and manipulate queries to improve process.
* Familiarity with another programming language such as VBA, .NET, R, Python is an advantage.

**Asst. Manager - CAT Modeling**
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage catastrophe modeling projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of client and business requirements.
* Review, validate, and approve exposure data, data scrubbing activities, quality checks, and model-ready datasets.
* Manage and mentor a team of catastrophe modeling analysts, providing technical guidance, training, and performance coaching.
* Oversee workload planning, resource allocation, and project prioritization to meet business objectives and service-level expectations.
* Drive data quality initiatives by identifying process gaps, implementing controls, and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Perform complex account, portfolio, and reinsurance analysis using catastrophe modeling platforms and internal tools.
* Collaborate with onshore stakeholders, underwriters, brokers, actuaries, and client teams to resolve data and modeling-related queries.
* Monitor project risks, track deliverables, and proactively communicate status, issues, and mitigation plans to management.
* Develop and enhance standard operating procedures, best practices, and process improvement initiatives.
* Review catastrophe model outputs, perform reasonability checks, and provide analytical insights to support business decisions.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, audit requirements, and data governance standards.
* Support transition activities, process documentation, knowledge management, and capability-building initiatives within the team.

**Skills and Experience:**

* 10+ years of experience in Catastrophe Modeling, exposure management, and insurance analytics.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience with catastrophe modeling platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or equivalent industry-standard tools.
* Proven expertise in exposure data review, data cleansing, financial validation, geo-coding, and portfolio quality assurance.
* Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing performance, and developing junior analysts.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
* Excellent understanding of insurance and reinsurance concepts, policy structures, CAT modeling methodologies, and financial terms.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, and data analysis techniques.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with global stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and client-facing skills.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics/ Statistics/ Operations Research/ Actuarial Science

title: Data Operation Analyst (India)
description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.
  
  
Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
  
  
Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
  
  
The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Data Operations Analyst**
who will work at the intersection of
**QBR technical support**
and
**Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) data analysis**
. This role requires a strong mix of technical expertise (SQL, Excel, data validation), critical thinking, and attention to detail. The Analyst will be responsible for creating and enhancing QBR decks, running custom analyses, and ensuring high-quality data accuracy within patient verification and benefits processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to deliver error-free, business-critical outputs for internal teams and clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Deck Creation & Automation:

+ Run daily deck automations to generate reports (10–15%).
+ Own direct connect decks end-to-end: ensure 100% QA, escalate concerning metrics, and transition high-revenue decks to AMs (10–15%).
+ Work on custom and strategic QBR decks (30–40%), including adding tailored slides, insights, and SQL/Excel analysis that elevate reporting beyond standard decks.

* Custom Analysis & Data QA
* Client-Facing Custom Analysis: Support ad hoc requests from clients, including detailed SQL and Excel-based analysis, and develop custom Retool dashboards where applicable.
* Data Verification: Validate that revenue transaction reports are accurately ingested from EHR systems and reconcile data discrepancies.
* Quality Assurance Testing: Develop and execute test plans for data ingestion, identify discrepancies, and document QA results.
* Mathematical/Financial Analysis: Apply quantitative reasoning to validate numerical accuracy in reports and ensure data integrity.
* Process Improvement: Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to streamline QA processes, data workflows, and reporting accuracy.
* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain records of QA activities, mappings, and findings, and present reports to stakeholders.
* Compliance: Ensure all data handling complies with HIPAA and other regulatory requirements.

**What You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Healthcare Informatics, or related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in data analysis, quality assurance, or technical reporting (healthcare/RCM preferred).
* Strong technical ability: Proficiency in SQL and Excel (including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros, and data analysis).
* Ability to perform quantitative reasoning to review metrics logically and identify inconsistencies.
* High attention to detail – able to spot even the smallest errors before work is released.
* Strong communication skills to relay insights, raise concerns, and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle and financial reporting (preferred).
* Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
* Growth mindset – ability to become semi-self-sufficient within 2–3 months.
* Willingness to work in India Night Shifts (US Day shift – EST to PST).

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in
**@**
**commure.com**
. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.
  
  
Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
**About Us**
TMB (Trusted Media Brands) is the world's leading community-driven entertainment company. Our portfolio of leading brands that includes FailArmy, Family Handyman, People Are Awesome, Reader’s Digest, Taste of Home, The Healthy, The Pet Collective, and Birds and Blooms, is powered by content that’s inspired and created by our fans. Engaging more than 200 million consumers worldwide, our content — available across streaming TV, social media, web, and print — sparks curiosity, fuels laughter, and inspires people to live big, full, fantastic lives. Learn more about our brands, our data-driven marketing solutions, our award-winning licensing services, and much more at www.tmbi.com.
  
  
**Location:**
We have offices in New York, Los Angeles, Milwaukee, and Gurgaon. We welcome you to work in our Gurgaon office, but you also have the opportunity to work from home.
  
  
**About The Role**
Data at TMB is seeking a skilled, creative, and technically well-rounded Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to join our team.
  
  
Reporting to the Vice President of Business Intelligence and Revenue Operations, the BI Analyst serves as a strategic bridge between the business and the broader Data organization. The Analyst works with business stakeholders to solve complex problems, clarify objectives, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguous needs into well-defined analytical problems.
  
  
The BI Analyst is instrumental in helping the business make the right decision. This may mean developing an analytical model, building a scalable reporting solution, partnering with data engineering to improve the underlying data, or working with data science on more advanced analytical approaches. Rather than simply producing dashboards or responding to requests, the analyst sits at the intersection of the data and the business to ensure the organization truly has the best business intelligence.
  
  
**About You**
You are a curious, commercially minded analyst who enjoys turning complex business problems into clear, scalable analytical solutions. You are comfortable working directly with stakeholders to understand their goals, challenge and refine requirements, and determine the right analytical approach, rather than simply responding to requests at face value. You see challenges as an opportunity and thrive in ambiguous environments.
  
  
You combine strong business judgment with analytical and technical fluency, allowing you to move from a complex question to a useful recommendation. You are proficient in Excel, SQL, and general data modeling. You can use technology as a means to best convey your story.
  
  
You are proactive, independent, and comfortable forming a point of view from the data. You communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, collaborate effectively across teams, and are excited about using emerging technologies, including AI, to make analytics more scalable, efficient, and impactful.
  
  
**Your day-day: (aka Responsibilities)**

* Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
* Develop analytical models to answer forecasting, testing, performance, and other business questions
* Analyze business performance, identify key drivers, and explain meaningful variances and trends
* Build executive-level presentations that turn analysis into clear recommendations and business narratives
* Create and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting tools, and analytical frameworks
* Work across Excel, Power BI, Data Studio, SQL, and other analytical tools to solve business problems
* Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science when problems require deeper data infrastructure or advanced analytical approaches.
* Improve the accuracy, usability, and scalability of the data and reporting used by the business

**You have:**

* 2–4+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or related field.
* Strong analytical critical thinking skills and intellectual curiosity
* Strong business judgment and understanding about what is driving performance
* Experience developing analytical models, reporting, or other decision support tools
* Ability to translate analysis into concise recommendations and executive-level presentations.
* Working knowledge of data modeling and general data architecture principles
* Proficiency with Excel, SQL, and BI tools such as Power BI, Data Studio, Looker, or Tableau
* Extremely strong communication skills and experience working directly with business stakeholders
* An independent and proactive mindset with comfort forming a point of view
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application to analytics is a plus.

**About this team:**
The wider Data team at TMB is an integrated group organized around three core functions: Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Data Science. Operating on a collaborative "Hub and Spoke" model, our BI team pairs dedicated analysts directly with specific teams to foster deep operational expertise and trusted cross-functional partnerships. We strive to be the analytical heartbeat of TMB, serving as a unified, pristine source of truth, where we look past face-value data with curiosity and rigor. We are a nimble, forward-thinking squad that actively leverages technology, including AI, to maximize tangible business ROI and guide every strategic decision with an expert, data-backed perspective.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs.
  
  
**India Specific Benefits**

* Comprehensive Time Off policies
* Maternity and Paternity Time off
* Health Insurance & Wellness Benefits including access to OPD consultations\*, Gym/Yoga studios, Teleconsultation/Telemedicine\*
* Access to Mental Health Reimbursement
* Annual Sport reimbursement and Home office reimbursement

If you’re passionate about ensuring quality and reliability of WordPress websites, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to be a part of our growing team at Trusted Media Brands.
  
  
Trusted Media Brands embraces inclusivity and values our diverse community. We are committed to building a team based on qualifications, merit and business need. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**This role is offered by TMB through Jukin Media India Private Limited.**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**What we are looking for in a candidate:**

**Experience- 2-5 years**

We are looking for a savvy Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. The hire will be responsible for expanding and optimizing our data and data pipeline architecture, as well as optimizing data flow and collection for cross functional teams. The ideal candidate is an experienced data pipeline builder and data wrangler who enjoys optimizing data systems and building them from the ground up. The Data Engineer will support our software developers, database architects, data analysts and data scientists on data initiatives and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. They must be self- directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems and products. The right candidate will be excited by the prospect of optimizing or even re-designing our company’s data architecture to support our next generation of products and data initiatives.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

● Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture, Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements.

● Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.

● Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and Azure/AWS ‘big data’ technologies.

● Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics.

● Work with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.

● Keep our data separated and secure across national boundaries through multiple data centers and AWS/Azure regions.

● Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader.

● Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.

**Qualifications for Data Engineer**

● Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.

● Experience building and optimizing ‘big data’ data pipelines, architectures and data sets.

● Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.

● Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.

● Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management.

● A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large disconnected datasets.

● Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable ‘big data’ data stores.

● Strong project management and organizational skills.

● Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Experience with big data tools: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, etc.

Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Postgres and Cassandra.

Experience with AWS/Azure cloud services: EC2, EMR, RDS, Redshift, HDInsights, DataLake, DataBricks

Experience with stream-processing systems: Storm, Spark-Streaming, etc.

Experience with object-oriented/object function scripting languages: Java, Python, Scala, etc.

* Implement data quality checks and monitoring to ensure accuracy and reliability.

title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Design and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies.
* Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns.
* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.
* Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design.
* Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to prototype rapidly while making clear distinctions between experimental code and production-ready solutions, including the risks and work required to transition between them.
* · Working knowledge of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, resiliency, performance, cost management, observability, and production support considerations.
* · Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain architecture choices and technical trade-offs to business leaders, subject-matter experts, architects, engineers, and risk partners.
* · Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment is beneficial.
* · Self-directed builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an evolving environment, partner constructively with enterprise IT, and balance delivery speed with reusable and supportable engineering practices

title: Analyst - Placements
description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Analyst – Placements will support the effective functioning of the Placements

Department through data management, placement analytics, reporting, and process

monitoring via ERP. The role will involve maintaining accurate placement records,

tracking student eligibility and placement progress, analysing placement outcomes,

and preparing management reports to support decision-making.

The position requires a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive professional who

can work closely with the placement team, students, and internal stakeholders to

ensure smooth and efficient execution of placement activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. Placement Data Management and Analytics

 Maintain and update the placement database, including student profiles,

academic details, CVs, placement status, interview progress, offers, and

joining details.

 Analyse placement data to track key performance indicators such as

placement percentage, average CTC, average fixed compensation, median

CTC, and the number of offers across salary brackets.

 Monitor placement progress against batch-wise targets and highlight gaps,

trends, and areas requiring intervention.

 Maintain accurate records of company-wise hiring, sector-wise placements,

role-wise offers, compensation packages, and recruiter engagement.

 Ensure data integrity, consistency, confidentiality, and timely updation of

placement records.

B. MIS and Management Reporting

Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic placement reports for the

placement leadership and institute management.

 Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and analytical reports using MS

Excel and other relevant tools.

 Prepare batch-wise and campus-wise placement summaries, recruiter

reports, and performance reports.

 Generate insights on placement trends, compensation benchmarks, sectoral

hiring patterns, and student placement progress.

 Support the preparation of placement presentations, review documents,

accreditation reports, rankings submissions, and annual placement reports, as

required.

C. Corporate Relations Support

 Maintain and update the corporate database, including company profiles,

recruiter contacts, hiring history, job roles, and compensation details.

 Track recruiter interactions, job descriptions received, hiring requirements,

interview schedules, and recruitment outcomes via ERP.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely sharing of student

profiles, CVs, shortlists, and other recruitment-related information with

companies.

D. Placement Process Coordination

 Track placement activities from job announcement and student applications

through shortlisting, interviews, offers, and final joining.

 Maintain trackers for student eligibility, applications, interview participation,

selection status, offer acceptance, and joining confirmation.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely communication of

recruitment schedules, deadlines, and process updates.

 Identify discrepancies or delays in placement data and follow up with relevant

stakeholders for closure.

 Support the smooth execution of placement drives, pre-placement talks,

assessments, interviews, and other recruitment activities.

E. Student Placement Tracking

 Maintain accurate student-wise records of placement readiness, applications,

interview performance, offers, and placement status.

 Track student participation and progress across recruitment processes.

Generate reports on student availability, placement eligibility, offer status, and

pending placement requirements.

 Assist in identifying students requiring additional placement support based on

data and feedback from the placement team.

 Ensure that placement-related student information is handled confidentially

and shared only with authorised stakeholders.

F. Process Improvement and Documentation

 Standardise placement data formats, reporting templates, trackers, and

documentation processes.

 Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, turnaround time, and

operational efficiency through automation and better data practices.

 Maintain proper documentation of placement processes, recruiter interactions,

and placement outcomes.

 Support data verification, audit requirements, and reconciliation of placement

figures before internal and external reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Analyst – Placements will be evaluated on the following

parameters:

1. Data Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of student, recruiter, offer, and

placement records.

2. Reporting Timeliness: Submission of placement MIS, dashboards, and

reports within defined timelines.

3. Target Tracking: Timely monitoring and reporting of placement progress

against approved batch-wise targets.

4. Analytical Quality: Quality of insights, trend analysis, exception reporting,

and management information provided.

5. Process Compliance: Adherence to placement data protocols, reporting

formats, and documentation standards.

6. Data Reconciliation: Consistency of placement figures across internal

trackers, dashboards, and official reports.

7. Stakeholder Coordination: Responsiveness and effectiveness in

coordinating with the placement team and relevant stakeholders.

8. Process Improvement: Contribution to improved reporting efficiency,

automation, and standardisation.

**Educational Qualifications:**

 Postgraduate qualification in Business Analytics, Management, Statistics, or a

related field.

6. Experience

 Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in MIS, data analytics,

reporting, operations, recruitment operations, or placement administration.

 Experience in an educational institution, business school, recruitment

organisation, or corporate HR function will be preferred.

7. Skills and Competencies

Technical Skills

 Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions,

conditional formulas, data validation, and dashboard preparation.

 Working knowledge of PowerPoint and professional report preparation.

 Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualisation tools will be an

advantage.

 Ability to work with large datasets, identify inconsistencies, and derive

meaningful insights.

 Familiarity with CRM systems, placement management platforms, or

database management tools is desirable.

title: Team Assistant
description:
**Job Description**
This role is part of the Independent Compliance Testing (ICT) team within the second-line Global Risk and Compliance (GRC) function. The ICT team conducts risk-based compliance testing across American Express products and portfolio segments to assess adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

The Global Risk & Compliance (GRC) organization serves as American Express’ independent risk management function. This person will ensure our CRM and outbound systems run on clean, enriched, deduped, and usable data, while building automations in n8n and Clay, and using tools like HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Lemlist, NeverBounce, and Bright Data.

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
The JDE Technical Specialist designs, develops, supports and improves technical solutions within JD Edwards EnterpriseOne. The role delivers reliable applications, reports, batch processes, integrations, orchestrations and data solutions while protecting production stability, security and auditability. Working closely with JDE functional consultants, business teams, CNC administrators, database specialists and external partners, the specialist converts functional requirements into maintainable technical solutions and provides advanced production support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, unit test, deploy and support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne custom applications, reports, batch applications, business functions and integrations.
* Work with functional consultants and business stakeholders to review requirements, identify standard capabilities, estimate effort and produce technical designs.
* Develop and maintain objects using the JDE EnterpriseOne toolset, including Object Management Workbench, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views and processing options.
* Build and support integrations using Orchestrator, REST or SOAP services, Business Services, EDI, flat files, database interfaces, middleware and scheduled jobs as applicable.
* Investigate complex production incidents involving application logic, batch processing, data integrity, interfaces, performance or environment-specific behavior.
* Perform root-cause analysis and deliver sustainable corrective actions rather than repeated data fixes or manual workarounds.
* Create technical specifications, object inventories, deployment instructions, rollback plans, unit-test evidence, support documentation and knowledge articles.
* Follow Object Management Workbench, package, promotion and change-management standards across development, test and production environments.
* Partner with CNC and infrastructure teams on package builds, deployments, server processes, logs, kernels, environment issues, tools releases and performance diagnostics.
* Analyze JDE tables and transaction relationships using SQL while following approved access, privacy and production-data controls.
* Review custom code for quality, security, performance, reusability and upgrade compatibility; reduce unnecessary customization where a standard option is viable.
* Support upgrades, tools releases, platform or cloud migrations, environment refreshes, disaster-recovery exercises and cutover activities.
* Monitor recurring failures and technical debt; recommend automation, observability, simplification and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor developers and support analysts, conduct peer reviews and improve shared technical knowledge across the support team.
* Liase with other support leads to troubleshoot integration issues including Boomi Cloud support team and external vendors.
* Oversee the resolution of incidents related to JDE/One World applications, ensuring timely response, escalation, and resolution according to established SLAs / KPIs.
* Lead the change management efforts, including training and communication plans, to ensure smooth adoption of new processes and features.
* Participate and contribute to Audit requirements.

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne technical development and support experience.
* Strong working knowledge of EnterpriseOne development tools and object types, including OMW, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views, versions and processing options.
* Exposure with JDE on OCI , Windows, Oracle Database environments..
* Experience developing or supporting interfaces, batch applications, reports and custom applications in a production ERP environment.
* Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Applications 9.2 and current EnterpriseOne Tools releases.
* Hands-on exposure to JDE Orchestrator, AIS, REST services, notifications, form extensions or other extensibility capabilities.
* Experience with Java, C, C++, JavaScript, XML, JSON, web services, SFTP, middleware or enterprise scheduling tools.
* Understanding of CNC concepts, package builds, path codes, environments, security and deployment architecture.
* Knowledge of JDE Financial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Project modules and their cross-module data flows.
* Experience in a global, multi-company, project-driven or engineering and construction environment.
* Proficiency with SQL and relational database concepts, including safe analysis of JDE data structures and transactional relationships.
* Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, monitoring, code-quality controls or CI/CD-adjacent processes for ERP development.
* Experience with software-development lifecycle practices, source/object control, peer review, unit testing, defect resolution and controlled deployment.
* Ability to interpret functional specifications and translate them into scalable technical designs.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills across functional, technical and business audiences.
* Experience handling high-priority production incidents with clear ownership, status communication and root-cause discipline.

**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.

AI Agents & Workflow Integration

15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Senior Associate Data Engineering L2
description:

Publicis Sapient is seeking a Senior Associate L2 – Data Engineering to join our high performing engineering team. In this role, you will translate client requirements into scalable data solutions and drive technical design discussions to ensure robust and efficient architectures. You will leverage your expertise in big data, cloud platforms, and data integration to build end-to-end data pipelines that power analytics and business transformation. This role is critical in enabling clients to unlock value through modern data ecosystems and advanced engineering practices.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Design and deliver scalable data engineering solutions to address complex business requirements.
* Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines for batch and real-time processing from multiple data sources.
* Implement robust data processing, storage, and computation frameworks ensuring performance and scalability.
* Drive architecture discussions and ensure the overall health and efficiency of data solutions.
* Develop analytics, aggregation, and search capabilities to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data platforms with business applications.
* Implement cloud-based data solutions leveraging AWS, Azure, or GCP platforms.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

title: Senior Data Engineering Manager - T&T
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
  
  
McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Data Engineering Manager at McCormick, you will play a pivotal role in the build and delivery of data products from simple to complex and supporting McCormick business units with their data and analytics needs.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include leading a team that delivers and supports data for existing analytics solutions, tooling, and solutions, researching new features and implementing automations. You will support business users, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to convert business expectations into data products and data models usable by business to deliver AI, analysis, reporting, and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and executives.
  
  
This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineering Manager will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 5+ source systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Plan and Design**

* Collaborate with data product managers to gather data product requirements.
* Design end-to-end solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.
* Prepare documentation and with data product managers to define the implementation plan.

**Data Extraction, Load and Transformation**

* Implement ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
* Ensure efficient and reliable data mapping to support business needs.
* Deliver complete documentation and knowledge transfer sessions for the Team and business partners.
* Maintain existing solutions, implement optimizations and enhancements, monitor data quality.
* Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL & performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high-quality, and reliable data flows.

**Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning**

* Collaborate with Data Science, Machine Learning and Business Analytics teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their analytics solutions.
* Identify and design internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability. Work with Azure Analytics Product Owner to prioritize and schedule implementation.
* Design and implement existing solution adjustments to improve performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Suggest and introduce best practices for Data and AI engineering.

**Issue Resolution and Support**

* Assist stakeholders with data-related technical issues and support their data needs. Work with the Analytics Operational Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve data errors / discrepancies.
* Provide expert-level support and guidance to data teams across the Enterprise.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of 8-10 data engineers.
* Define technical standards, code review practices, and engineering excellence frameworks.
* Build career paths, upskilling programs, and succession plans within data engineering.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Be accountable for building a winning data engineering team – driven by making data a core asset for McCormick.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field; Masters in technical field or MBA a plus
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203+AZ305)
* or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/databricks certifications a plus
* 12+ years of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with data visualization software (Power BI preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.
* Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with the following tooling:
* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD),
* OR
* GCP BigQuery, FiveTran, GCP Cloud Composer, GCP DLP (Data Loss Prevention), GCP Cloud Run, Vertex AI etc

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Data Platform Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Snowflake Data Warehouse
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
AI Agents & Workflow Integration
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Lead Data Warehouse Engineer
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures. FairMoney maintains a strong international presence, with offices in several countries, including France, Nigeria, Germany, Latvia, the UK, Türkiye, and India.
  
  
In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

We are looking for a
**Lead Data Warehouse Engineer**
to own FairMoney's data warehouse and lead the team that builds it. You will set the architecture, the modelling and quality standards, and the delivery roadmap for the data our lending, banking, risk and finance teams depend on. You will stay hands-on in architecture, design reviews and critical models while you lead and grow a team of data engineers.

1.
**Data Platform and Architecture**

* Own the architecture of the cloud data warehouse, from ingestion to the published datasets used by analysts, BI tools and downstream systems.
* Lead the modernisation of the data platform, including the move to CDC and streaming ingestion.
* Decide which layer each piece of business logic belongs in, and keep published datasets stable for the teams that use them.
* Manage compute and storage cost and deliver measurable efficiency gains.

2.
**Data Modelling and Engineering Standards**

* Set and enforce standards for data modelling, transformation patterns, testing, documentation and code review.
* Build data quality and observability practices that catch issues before consumers find them. ●
* Run a clear change process, with design review, QC evidence and peer review, before changes reach production.
* Drive automation and CI/CD across the data stack.

3.
**Reliability and Operations**

* Own freshness, accuracy and availability SLAs for business-critical datasets, and the on-call and incident response behind them
* Guide the team through complex issues in distributed data pipelines.

4.
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of data engineers
* Set the team's working rhythm: intake and triage, sprint planning, design reviews and stakeholder reporting.

5.
**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Be the main engineering partner to business, product, risk and finance leaders.
* Turn business requirements into reliable data products, explain trade-offs clearly and deliver on predictable timelines
* Make sure data handling meets financial regulatory, governance and security requirements.

6.
**AI and Self-Serve**

* Prepare the warehouse for AI use cases with documented models, consistent metric definitions and a semantic layer.
* Bring AI-assisted engineering and analytics into the team's daily work.

**Requirements**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineers.
* Expert SQL and strong Python.
* Deep data modelling experience: dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, and incremental and idempotent transformations.
* Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
* Production experience with dbt and a workflow orchestrator such as Airflow.
* End-to-end ownership of business-critical datasets, with accountability for freshness, correctness and SLAs
* Experience in fintech, banking or financial services.
* A record of hiring, retaining and growing strong engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management, including the ability to say no and explain why

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Experience working with CDC or streaming ingestion (Kafka, Debezium or similar)
* Experience with data governance, data contracts and lineage
* Indepth knowledge on data quality and observability tooling
* Semantic layers and GenAI / LLM tooling on structured data
* Leading teams across time zones

**Benefits**

* Training & Development

* Performance Bonus

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening call with the Recruiter for 30 minutes
* Technical interview with the Hiring Manager for 45 minutes

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems
