title: Senior Engineer
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. title: Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer – Privacy-Preserving Data Platform
description:
We are looking for skilled Data Engineers at mid-level and senior levels to build, maintain, and operate reliable, scalable, and privacy-preserving data pipelines on AWS. The ideal candidates will have strong expertise in Python, SQL, distributed data processing, and production-grade ETL pipelines, along with experience in data orchestration, data quality, and CI/CD practices.

The role involves extracting data from transactional systems and Amazon Athena, transforming it into curated Parquet datasets, and implementing robust de-identification processes to ensure appropriate handling of sensitive data.

Key Responsibilities

* Build data extraction pipelines from transactional systems and Amazon Athena-based data lakes.
* Develop, transform, and maintain curated datasets in Parquet format.
* Implement data de-identification and privacy-preserving transformations, with automated tests to validate the handling classification of every data column.
* Manage data pipeline orchestration, scheduling, retries, backfills, monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in collaboration with the platform team.
* Maintain data catalogs, lineage information, and documentation for all datasets produced.
* Monitor and support production data pipelines, troubleshoot failures, and manage schema changes in upstream systems.
* Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, maintainability, and consistency through sound software engineering practices.

Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Python and SQL**
  .
* Experience with
  **Apache Spark or equivalent distributed data processing technologies**
  .
* Proven experience building and operating production-grade batch data pipelines on
  **AWS**
  .
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as
  **Apache Airflow, Dagster, AWS Step Functions, or similar**
  .
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and data lake architectures.
* Experience with version control, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong understanding of idempotency, pipeline recovery, backfills, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to follow written technical standards and engineering specifications.

Additional Skills – Good to Have

* Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) tools such as Debezium or AWS DMS.
* Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
* Exposure to data masking, tokenization, de-identification, or other privacy-enhancing technologies.
* Experience with dbt or comparable data transformation frameworks.
* Experience building datasets for machine learning model training and understanding how their requirements differ from reporting datasets.

Additional Requirements for the Senior Data Engineer

* Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance.
* Proven ownership of data systems from design and implementation through production operations.
* Experience managing on-call responsibilities and resolving production incidents.
* Ability to evaluate architectural decisions, challenge unsuitable designs, and drive engineering best practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Data Engineer who combines strong coding skills with practical experience operating production data platforms. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise data platforms that enable secure, scalable, and high-quality data solutions across the organization. This role combines strategic architecture with hands-on engineering, ensuring that data platforms support analytics, AI, operational reporting, regulatory compliance, and business transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate partners closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, application teams, security, and governance functions to build modern cloud-native data ecosystems while establishing enterprise standards for architecture, data quality, governance, security, and platform operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Data Architecture**

* Design and maintain enterprise data architecture that aligns with business strategy and technology roadmaps.
* Define logical, conceptual, and physical data models across operational and analytical platforms.
* Develop scalable architecture patterns for data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, and modern analytics platforms.
* Establish standards for metadata, lineage, master data, reference data, and data lifecycle management.
* Drive technology evaluations and architectural decisions for cloud-based data platforms.

**Data Platform Engineering**

* Design, build, and optimize enterprise data platforms using cloud-native technologies.
* Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
* Implement infrastructure automation and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices.
* Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and cost across cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot platform issues and continuously improve operational resilience.

**Data Governance & Security**

* Design and implement enterprise data governance frameworks.
* Lead initiatives involving confidential data identification, classification, masking, tokenization, encryption, and access control.
* Define and implement data retention, auditing, and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with Security, Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
* Establish enterprise metadata management and data lineage capabilities.

**Data Quality & Reliability**

* Develop enterprise data quality frameworks including validation, reconciliation, completeness, accuracy, and monitoring.
* Implement automated quality controls within ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Define KPIs and metrics to measure platform health and data quality.
* Lead initiatives that improve trust in enterprise data assets.

**Cloud Platform Administration**

* Administer enterprise analytics platforms including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure and AWS environments
* Manage workspace provisioning, Unity Catalog governance, compute optimization, storage management, and platform security.
* Implement role-based access controls and least-privilege security models.
* Monitor platform utilization, capacity planning, and cost optimization.

**Analytics Enablement**

* Partner with BI teams to enable trusted enterprise reporting.
* Support semantic models, reporting platforms, and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Ensure data products are discoverable, reusable, and governed.

**Architecture Leadership**

* Lead architecture reviews and technical design sessions.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams and mentor junior architects and engineers.
* Define enterprise best practices, standards, and reusable design patterns.
* Review solution designs for scalability, maintainability, security, and performance.

**Operational Excellence**

* Improve platform reliability through monitoring, automation, observability, and incident response.
* Develop operational runbooks and disaster recovery strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across platform operations.
* Support production deployments and release management.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance, HR, Operations, Product, Security, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements.
* Translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions and technical strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives involving multiple business units and external vendors.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/ Information Systems/Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Platform Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of modern data architecture principles including Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and Data Fabric concepts.
* Experience implementing enterprise data governance and security frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale technical initiatives from design through production.

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure (Preferred), AWS
* Data Platforms: Databricks (Required), Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage
* Databases: SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Delta Lake
* Data Engineering: Spark, PySpark, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT pipeline development, Streaming and batch processing
* Governance & Metadata: Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Data Catalogs, Data Lineage, Data Classification, Data Masking, Data Quality Frameworks
* DevOps & Automation: Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CI/CD Pipelines
* Reporting & Analytics: Power BI, Semantic Models, DAX, Data Modeling

**About Kroll**
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity - not just answers - in all areas of business. We value the diverse backgrounds and perspectives that enable us to think globally. As part of One team, One Kroll, you’ll contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
Kroll is the premier global valuation and corporate finance advisor with expertise in complex valuation, disputes and investigations, M&A, restructuring, and compliance and regulatory consulting. Our professionals balance analytical skills, deep market insight and independence to help our clients make sound decisions. As an organization, we think globally—and encourage our people to do the same.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations and more people.
  
  
Pioneering technology takes more than just inventive engineers. At Dyson, we take a problem-solving approach to everything we do. And across our support teams, we’re proud to be different. And importantly, we support change to maintain our rapid growth
  
  
Digital HRIS function organization provides process and service excellence to support Dyson’s growth ambitions with a goal of innovating and enhancing employee services over time to meet the changing needs of the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
Part of a team of functional managers and specialists, the role is fundamental to supporting and advancing Dyson’s usage of the core Human Capital Management system (Workday). This role will serve as an HR Technology point of contact for HR functional areas and assists HR subject matter experts to identify, plan and implement systems and process improvements. The specialist will have responsibility for the successful implementation, integration, configuration, and support of Workday applications from project initiation to production roll-out.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will strive to deliver a 'best in class', efficient service and will be a valued member of the wider People and Dyson Business Services communities at Dyson.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support global business users and HR by troubleshooting system issues, resolving defects, maintaining system data structures, assisting with ad-hoc reporting requests, and administering biannual Workday-related processes.
* Take ownership of queries and actively manage them, providing best-in-class technical solutions and stakeholder support while ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) with deep knowledge of Workday integrations and modules, including configuration, testing, and implementation across HCM, Reporting & Analytics, Compensation, Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Security, and related areas.
* Conduct working sessions with stakeholders to gather, understand, and analyze business and technical requirements, recommending solutions based on best practices and feasibility.
* Collaborate with requestors, project managers, business analysts, HR business partners, and QA staff to ensure requirements are fully understood, including reviewing technical designs and testing documentation.
* Configure and implement changes or updates to Workday integrations and modules, managing and promoting these through the appropriate technical (solution) development and change management processes.
* Support delivery of key projects, including Workday integration enhancements, HR system changes, and improvements to stakeholder experience.
* Develop and implement scalable, flexible integration solutions that can adapt to future business needs.
* Advise stakeholders on industry standards and best practices, ensuring clean configuration and streamlined processes.
* Ensure users leverage Workday best practices effectively.
* Maintain up-to-date process documentation and learning materials, including GWIs, FAQs, and training guides.
* Engage in continuous self-learning through Workday Community and other available channels.
* Actively contribute to HR-wide and cross-functional initiatives as required.

**About You**
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong experience in requirements gathering, solution design, delivery, and ongoing support of Workday integration projects. This includes hands-on expertise in tools such as Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and APIs, applied across multiple functional areas (e.g., Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Recruiting, etc).
  
  
**Experience**

* Degree in Information Technology / Computer Science/ Business or other related fields
* Minimum 3–5 years of Workday integration experience
* Hands-on involvement in at least one full lifecycle Workday integration and implementation project
* Strong background in Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and Workday APIs
* Experience working in a multinational technology organization with complex system landscapes
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with maturity
* Knowledge and experience across a range of SaaS HRIS and web-based talent management or HR service delivery tools, with emphasis on system integration and data flows
* Extensive HR systems reporting, HR process, and project management experience
* Familiarity with HCM concepts, HR processes, and a basic understanding of HR policies and procedures (ensure integration design aligns with business requirements)
* Workday Integration certification is a must.

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail in technical configurations
* Strong organizational and time management skills, able to react quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* A collaborative team player with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally with HR, other stakeholders, and third-party vendor
* Proactive approach to delivering effective technical solutions, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.
* Results-oriented, with awareness of goals and standards, ensuring quality and productivity are consistently met
* Ability to prioritize workload, analyse complex problems, and demonstrate resilience in overcoming technical barriers

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

in accordance with

assist

title: Principal Analyst, BI Service Delivery
description:

This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.
  
  
This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.
  
  
This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.
* Own service excellence and continuous improvement, establishing service roadmaps, proactive monitoring, support procedures, and improvement initiatives based on stakeholder demand and customer feedback.
* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.
* Ensure strong governance and operational readiness through adherence to release management processes and maintenance of accurate system documentation, requirements, test scripts, knowledge articles, configuration information, and support procedures.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in data and analytics, including designing and developing scalable, high-quality solutions across SAP BW and Microsoft Azure platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BW, Databricks, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF) and ETL technologies such as Informatica; SAP BW certification preferred.

* Experience designing and supporting cross-application integrations involving SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms, along with exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal/external relationships and simplify complex technical concepts into actionable plans; MedTech industry experience preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
  
  
This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
  
  
The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
  
  
What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end-to-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Associate Manager, Data Delivery & Dashboard
description:
**Job Description**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of complex data outputs for our healthcare market research projects. The team is responsible for conducting comprehensive quality checks on large datasets, transforming and standardising data files to meet project and client requirements, and managing delivery through automated and off-the-shelf dashboard solutions. By combining technical precision with a client-focused approach, the team enables timely, insightful, and accessible data visualisation that supports strategic decision-making across our global research initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team Lead role will report into the Sr Manager. The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team lead will be a key member of the India-based Data Management & Delivery Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets for STEM. As a Dashboard Developer Team lead, you build and maintain high impact dashboards and data visualizations that transform raw market research data into actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with researchers, analysts, and engineers to ensure data flows seamlessly from collections to visual storytelling. You will also support the team in delivering insightful, user-friendly dashboards through automated tools and off-the-shelf solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in data management, quality assurance, and data visualisation, while working alongside an experienced team in a dynamic, global environment. Skill Set required
  
  
**STEM Dashboard Discovery Phase**
One of primary responsibilities would be to streamline the overall data collection process and create dashboards
  
  
**Brand Equity tracking support with our in-house platform:**

* Maintain the pipeline for the project data process flow (this includes receival of data into in-hosue Tool, through the data processing stage into the storage mart, through the python utilities into required outputs)
* Maintain and update Power BI Dashboard when required due to changes from the research team
* Manage and rectify when failures occur in the dashboard, liaising with both the data providers, research team and developers on the Pipeline
* Manage the storage mart and data warehouse
* Support team with edits in-house platform

**Data Quality Checks:**
Assist in performing detailed quality control checks on large and complex datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  
  
**Data Transformation & Standardisation:**
Support the transformation and standardisation of data files to align with internal data structures, project needs, and client-specific formats.
  
  
**Dashboard Support & Maintenance:**
Lead in the creation, population, and maintenance of dashboards using off-the-shelf tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms), ensuring outputs are clear, accurate, and aligned with research objectives.
  
  
**Data Delivery Management:**
Manage and organise the final delivery of data files and dashboards to internal teams and clients, ensuring timely and error-free execution.
  
  
**Collaboration Across Teams:**
Work closely with internal stakeholders including Development team, Data Processing, Scripting, Project Management and Research teams to ensure smooth handovers and integration of deliverables.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain clear documentation of processes, data transformation steps, and QC logs to support transparency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness.
  
  
**Continuous Learning & Development:**
Engage in training opportunities to build knowledge in healthcare data, market research workflows, dashboarding tools, and data handling best practices.
  
  
**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**
**Technical Expertise**

* At least 6+ years expertise in Power BI, Power query , DAX, data modeling, Quality assurance, SQL
* Experience in Building interactive, user-friendly dashboards
* Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, etc.)
* Understanding and building of ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Expert level Knowledge of Python
* Proficient in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP), and building ETL/ELT pipelines is a plus
* Experience in version control system.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:
  
  

* A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration
* A relaxed and friendly working environment

**About Inizio Advisory:**
Research Partnership is part of Inizio Advisory, a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
JD:
**Senior Platform Architect (Tech Lead)**

**Location:**
Noida

**Reports to:**
CTO

**Type:**
Full-time, individual contributor tech lead

**About Sutra.AI**

Sutra.AI is a complete ‘Data to Value’ AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available

Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* Experience in Financial Services or another controlled or regulated environment.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, data governance, access controls and audit requirements.

**Personal attributes**

* Hands-on, structured and delivery-focused, with strong attention to detail.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can work closely with clients to understand their business processes, design and build technology solutions, integrate enterprise systems, and take solutions into production.

title: Data Operations Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience understanding complex data structures, schemas, and migration requirements, combined with proficiency in extract, transform, and load processes across enterprise environments.
* 3-7 years’ experience required for this role. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and validation, with experience mapping data fields between source and target systems to meet business rules and technical requirements.
* Knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality assurance best practices, and data governance principles, including documentation of business rules, standard operating procedures, and data lineage.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, and hands-on experience with reporting and automation tools including Power Automate, Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks; experience with master data management tools such as Collibra or DBeaver preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong problem-solving ability; capable of collaborating across business users, data stewards, and technical teams while clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's / postgraduation degree in finance or Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field required

**Responsibilities**

* Supports enterprise-wide data migration initiatives by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions across systems.
* Analyzes data structures and identifies migration requirements, collecting, cleaning, and validating datasets from multiple source systems
* Documents business rules for data quality checks and applies validation and quality assurance techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
* Maps data fields from source to target systems and transforms data to align with new system requirements and business rules
* Executes data migration processes including extraction, transformation, and loading, monitoring migration progress and troubleshooting issues in real time
* Identifies and resolves data discrepancies, errors, and anomalies, collaborating with technical teams to implement corrective actions
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and visualizations to highlight key trends and document data quality issues for stakeholder review
* Works closely with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to gather requirements, communicate progress, and facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure a smooth migration transition
* Creates and maintains comprehensive documentation including migration plans, data mappings, validation rules, standard operating procedures, and post-migration reports to support governance and audit readiness

**About The Team**
Our Ratings Operations and Controls (ROC) team is responsible for supporting the data management, quality, and operational processes that underpin Moody's global ratings and research activities. We contribute to Moody's by ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and consistency across critical systems, enabling seamless data transitions that support business continuity and analytical integrity, and driving operational efficiency through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in enterprise data migration, digital transformation, and process innovation across our Gurgaon operations.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
  
  
For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page
  
  
Please note: STP categories are assigned by the hiring teams and are subject to change over the course of an employee’s tenure with Moody’s.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery
  
  
Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely
  
  
with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical
  
  
requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success
  
  
through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the
  
  
project lifecycle.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant
  
  
you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to
  
  
meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather
  
  
requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to
  
  
AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging
  
  
technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the
  
  
implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and
  
  
managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers
  
  
realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with
  
  
customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud
  
  
computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which
  
  
help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also
  
  
deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of
  
  
solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to

customer needs
  
  

* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project

delivery
  
  

* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective

migration strategies
  
  

* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging

technologies
  
  

* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating

reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or Math
* 5+ years of practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large-scale applications experience
* 8+ years of processing data with a massively parallel technology (such as Redshift, Teradata, Netezza, Spark or Hadoop based big data solution) experience
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* 7+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or experience with AWS Solutions, including EC2, S3, Redshift, EMR (or Hadoop)
* Experience using managed ML/AI solutions
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT or similar platforms in production environments
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* 4+ years of professional work experience, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Generative AI trends, patterns, anti-patterns

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Staff Architect II, Software & Data Architecture
description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


**Glassdoor's Best Places to Work**
 

list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. **WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**

 

Y

ou'll join Bain's NextGen Software Solutions (NGSS) team, where we build and support software products that help power the firm's work.

As a Staff Architect II, you'll be the technical owner of a

**Coro**

 product workstream within NGSS. The Coro team is focused on building and scaling Bain's proprietary data and product e

cosystem. We develop and manage platforms such as BizMap and Helix, which power data-driven insights and solutions across Bain's commercial and private equity practices.

* Define and document the workstream architecture, ensuring alignment with the shared platform design and Bain-wide Azure, make key design decisions on data flow, service boundaries, and integration patterns
* Collaborate with AI Engineers to design LLM orchestration and tool-calling architecture for product-specific agents, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency at scale
