* Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams across products, services, and projects
* Run technical standups, manage individual workloads, provide structured feedback, and grow junior engineers while maintaining delivery pace
* Support team in recruiting activities (resume screening, interviews, etc.)

**Stakeholder Alignment**

* Ensure the workstream's builds stay compatible with and contribute back to the shared Bain platform
* Represent the workstream team in technical touchpoints with practice leadership and external engineering partners

**Innovation & Emerging Technologies**

* Drive innovation through out-of-the-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs
* Investigate and keep up-to-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches
* Comfortable in a consulting-adjacent product context, turning ambiguous requirements into well-scoped engineering work

**ABOUT YOU**

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Engineering degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience

**Technical**

* Software and data architecture experience in a senior technology leadership role
* Track record in building and running scalable cloud-based B2B software products
* Strong backend experience in Python (FastAPI or similar), with Node.js and C# /  ASP.NET in the stack, plus TypeScript/React for full-stack work
* Deep experience with cloud-native Azure (Container Apps, Functions) and containerized deployments (Docker, Docker Compose)
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs and agent orchestration frameworks, enough to make sound design calls on agent structure, tool-calling, and prompt management
* Working knowledge of data pipelines and stores (SQL schemas, ETL, data quality) across relational and analytical systems (Azure SQL, Postgres, Snowflake)

* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to speed up development
* Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in a fast-paced Agile environment
* Results-driven, with an analytical, creative, and proactive mindset

**Experience**

* 8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years as a staff architect or technical team lead responsible for team delivery of large features or full products
* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment
* Experience managing engineering teams, including conflict and dependency resolution
* Demonstrated ability to manage communication across project stakeholders and external vendors

title: Senior Member, Tech (All positions)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for bright and exceptional programmers to join our Software Developer teams based in the firm's offices in Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram. We have requirements across various teams whose work spans the entire life cycle of a trade, scalable, high-performing data APIs in support of our Quant research, the systems supporting post-trade, accounting, valuation, and reporting operations, infrastructure solutions for analytic computations, and critical applications that support legal workflows. Because the software we build is closely tied to the performance of the firm's investments and to its day-to-day operations, the work done by these teams is highly critical and impactful.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will execute individual projects and deliverables while collaborating with business groups, driving complete project lifecycles from collecting and analyzing requirements through design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will work closely with a broad set of stakeholders, translating their needs into well-reasoned technical proposals and carrying those proposals through to delivery while holding a high bar for both quality and timelines. You will also perform R&D to evaluate the appropriate technologies to use and resolve application and data issues in production within timelines. You will explore and apply generative AI both to solve business problems and to accelerate your own work across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting. You will build robust domain knowledge in the business you support, continually look for ways to improve the existing setup, and strike the right balance between pragmatic near-term solutions and long-term maintainability. You will provide direction and guidance to junior members of the team, participate actively in code and design reviews, and contribute to an excellent engineering culture through documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with a solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented design
* 2 to 4 years of robust programming experience in one or more of C++, Java, or Python, along with the willingness to work in a language-agnostic environment
* Robust low-level design (LLD) skills and the ability to translate requirements into clean, maintainable, well-structured code
* Demonstrated technical problem-solving ability, high quantitative aptitude, and a solid grasp of core computer science fundamentals
* The ability to work independently, with focus, discipline, and attention to detail, in an agile and interdisciplinary environment
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, along with good interpersonal and reasoning ability

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with front-end technologies such as React, along with RESTful web services, messaging middleware, and relational databases
* Experience working with large datasets and building scalable, high-performing data pipelines, libraries, or APIs
* Exposure to the finance domain or familiarity with financial markets

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrMemTechAug26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.
  
  
**Role Description**
This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.
  
  
The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.
* Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.
* Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.
* Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.
* Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.

title: Assistant Manager -Flight Operations Engineer
description:
**Brief About The Role/ Team/ Candidate Requirement**
The role supports the airline’s operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and environmental performance through a combination of data analytics, performance engineering, and CORSIA compliance activities. The position is responsible for generating actionable reports and dashboards from fuel and operational efficiency platforms such as SkyBreathe, Skywise, and AIMS, enabling continuous monitoring of fuel burn, operational performance, and efficiency trends. These insights support data-driven decision-making across Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, and Fuel Management teams.
  
  
The role works closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, Fuel Management, Finance, Sustainability/ESG, A key component of the role involves managing CORSIA-related activities, including the calculation of annual offsetting requirements as per CAR/ICAO guidelines, preparation of Annual Emissions Reports (AER), and maintenance of comprehensive compliance records. This includes emissions data, third-party verification reports, and offset purchase and cancellation documentation, ensuring full audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* BE / B.Tech - Computer science / AI &ML / Aeronautics or
* BSc - Math / Physics / Statistics
* Data scientist / Data analyst
* Minimum 4 years

**Skill set**

* Python / SQL
* POWER BI / Tableau
* QGIS / ARC GIS / Terrain Mapping
* Data Visualization and Reporting
* Sound knowledge of MS office tools Including power point for presentation

**Key Competencies**

* Dashboards, Reports, hand on experience on BI Application
* Knowledge of A/C Performance and Air regulations and aeronautical charts aspects.
* Knowledge of AIMS / JOC / Rostering system.

**Job responsibility**
**Fuel Efficiency & Operational Performance Monitoring**
Monitor and analyze fuel consumption, operational performance, and efficiency trends across the airline network.
  
  
Utilize platforms such as SkyBreathe, Skywise, AIMS, and other operational databases to generate actionable insights.
  
  
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reports to support data-driven decision making.
  
  
**Data Analytics & Reporting**
Create, automate, and maintain performance reports and business intelligence dashboards.
  
  
Analyze flight operations data to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
Support strategic initiatives through data modeling and operational analytics.
  
  
**CORSIA Compliance Management**
Act as a focal point for CORSIA compliance activities and emissions reporting.
  
  
Calculate annual CORSIA offsetting requirements in accordance with ICAO and DGCA/CAR requirements.
  
  
Prepare and submit Annual Emissions Reports (AER) and supporting regulatory documentation.
  
  
Ensure accurate monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of fuel burn and emissions data.
  
  
**Emissions Data Governance & Audit Readiness**
Maintain complete and accurate records of emissions data, offset purchases, and offset cancellation certificates.
  
  
Coordinate with internal and external verifiers during audits and compliance reviews.
  
  
Perform data quality checks, validation, and reconciliation of emissions and fuel consumption records.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management**
Collaborate with Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, Fuel Management, Finance, ESG/Sustainability, Digital, and Regulatory teams.
  
  
Provide data and compliance support for management reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Monitor airline environmental performance indicators and carbon efficiency metrics.
  
  
Benchmark operational efficiency and sustainability performance against established targets.

description:
**Job Description**
Data Engineer II facilitates seamless data integration and model maintenance, enhances data pipelines and database designs, supports production environments, ensures compliance with enterprise standards, and fosters collaboration while implementing basic partitioning and indexing solutions for Big Data management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Evaluates data requirements and stories, documents them for seamless integration into existing architectures, and maintains data models to support business needs
* Builds and enhances data pipelines and database designs to meet performance, scalability, and security requirements
* Should have good hands on with GCP technologies like : BigQuery, DataProc and other services of GCP.
* Have good working knowledge of SQL and data evaluation tools.
* Collaborates in design reviews and testing, and provides production environment support with guidance from peers and leaders
* Completes work reviews and fosters a collaborative learning environment with guidance from peers and leaders
* Communicates and collaborates with business and product teams to facilitate changes and implementation
* Completes Big Data/Spark and Other distributed frameworks requirements by implementing basic partitioning and indexing solutions
* Collaborates and co-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives

**Qualifications**
Education Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
* Knowledge of Big Data / NoSQL design and development with variety of data stores.
* Knowledge of database management system products and ecosystem – e.g., storage formats, access algorithms, data management processes, administration, data maintenance, replication, high availability, encryption, etc.
* Knowledge of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational & non-relational database

**Work Experience**

* Data engineering and 4+ years of experience in development.
* Have good experience in performance tuning of large data processing in both batch and real-time.
* Experience in SQL and Python (or any other programming language like Java)
* Experience in design and development across one or more database management systems (e.g., HBase, Hive, GCP tools, NoSQL, BigTable, BigQuery, Cloud Spanner) as appropriate.
* Experience in NoSQL databases (e.g., Hbase, BigTable)
* Experience in performance tuning in the Big Data space
* Experience in distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and application development
* Experience in database development and support of online transaction processing and/or online analytical processing systems
* Experience in software delivery methodology (Agile, Scrum, Agile XP, Test-Driven Development etc.)
* GCP Certificate will be good add-on.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Manager Software/Data Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**

Manager Software/Data Engineer
**Experience**

8 – 12 years

About CoPoint AI

CoPoint AI is a specialized consulting firm focused on transforming businesses through process improvement, data insights, and technology-driven innovation. We leverage AI technologies, Microsoft cloud platforms, and modern web development frameworks to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that drive measurable impact for our clients. Our team partners across industries to design and deploy solutions that streamline operations, enhance customer experiences, and enable data-driven growth.

Our Vision

We transform businesses through process improvement and data insights leveraging AI on the Microsoft stack

Our Values

* Be Purposeful: Think Straight, Communicate, Always Do The Right Thing
* In Partnership: With our Team, For our Clients, In our communities.
* Create Impact: Deliver value-based solution, help Individual achieve their dream, demand profitable growth.

Role Overview

Manager Software/Data Engineer will lead client-facing engagements through hands-on design, development, and delivery of AI and data-driven solutions for enterprise customers. This is a full-time role based out of our Gurgaon office. Around 80% of the role is hands-on engineering and delivery, and around 20% is people management, which means leading, mentoring and growing a small team of engineers. You will own technical decisions on your projects, work closely with client stakeholders, and collaborate day-to-day with onshore and offshore peers to bring high-impact AI and analytics work to life. The role DOES require Five days in the office. If you are looking for a 100% remote role, this is not for you – consulting is a contact sport!

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the design and build of end-to-end web application data and AI solutions, while staying hands-on across the stack
* Own the technical direction on your projects, including architecture decisions, code reviews and release quality
* Build and optimize secure, scalable APIs and microservices using Node.js, TypeScript and cloud-native principles
* Develop responsive, user-friendly web applications using React and Next.js, integrated with enterprise data systems

* Design and manage data models and databases, mainly on PostgreSQL and SQL Server
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes, with CI/CD pipelines on Azure
* Implement AI-powered features in web applications using LLMs, Azure OpenAI, and Cognitive Services
* Drive AI-assisted software development lifecycle improvements across the team
* Help maintain frameworks for responsible AI governance and model monitoring
* Run project workstreams with onshore and offshore delivery teams, and raise risks and scope changes early
* Be the day-to-day technical point of contact for clients, with clear and consistent communication
* Manage a small team of engineers (around 20% of the role): run 1:1s, set goals, give regular feedback and support their growth
* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding of new team members
* Maintain high quality and consistency in code, solutions, and user experience

Qualifications

* 8 – 12 years of experience in software or data engineering, with at least 2 years of leading engineers or project teams
* Experience implementing AI solutions on any tech stack, with direct involvement in build and deployment
* Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js and React / Next.js
* Good working knowledge of PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD on Azure or AWS
* Working knowledge of large language models and their business applications
* Hands-on proficiency in developing custom AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, and ML services
* Experience integrating AI into existing enterprise applications.
* Experience managing client engagements and delivering high-quality, reliable solutions
* Experience mentoring or managing engineers, including feedback and performance conversations
* Strong technical problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities
* Excellent communication skills, with comfort collaborating across onshore and offshore teams

What should You expect:

* A culture of continuous learning with certification support.
* Clear career advancement pathways.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* A collaborative environment that values innovation and creativity.

*Ready to shape the future of enterprise technology? Join our team of Microsoft technology experts and make an impact.*

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Business Intelligence Engineer**

Are you passionate about transforming data into clarity, building powerful BI solutions, and enabling teams to make smarter decisions?

Do dashboards, data models, and seamless pipelines spark your creativity?

If yes, then you might be the
**Business Intelligence Engineer**
we’re looking for.

At
**Boutiqaat,**
data is at the heart of every decision, and we need a builder, innovator, and problem-solver who can elevate how we collect, structure, and visualize information. You’ll develop and maintain BI interfaces, create intuitive dashboards, support key business strategies, and ensure our data flows are efficient, accurate, and actionable.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.

**Ready to Grow with Us?**

Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.

Apply now and be part of something exciting!

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment
description:
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment**

**About Urban Company**

Urban Company is Asia's largest tech-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high-quality, and reliable experience every single time.

**About the Fulfilment Team**

The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:

- Planning & Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.

- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.

- Allocation & Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.

These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.

**Job Description: SDE-2**

We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE-2) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.

**Responsibilities**

- Design and build scalable, high-performance, fault-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.

- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.

- Own features end-to-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.

- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.

**What Are We Looking For?**

- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large-scale backend applications or Products.

-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.

- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.

- AI Fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging AI in day-to-day engineering — using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.

- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.

- Mindset: Bias for action, end-to-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.

- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

**Why Join Us?**

- Work on marketplace-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.

- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.

- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first-principles thinking.

title: SAP MM/PP Master Data Engineer - Enterprise Data Management
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. * Enterprise Data Architecture: Lead the functional design and governance for critical supply chain data domains, including but not limited to Material Master, BOM, ECN (Engineering Change Management), Routing, Production Versions (PV).

* Process Automation: Design and implement custom workflows and automated solutions for the "Part Creation" lifecycle to reduce manual entry and accelerate time-to-market.
* Integrated Supply & Demand Planning: Partner with business leaders to align Supply & Demand Planning requirements with master data support, ensuring that data structures are optimized for advanced planning systems such as SAP IBP, APO, and Anaplan.
* Custom Object Support: Strong experience in defining and supporting custom SAP objects tailored to specific complex manufacturing or supply chain business requirements.
* Collaborate with different IT and business teams to translate complex supply chain and semiconductor requirements into scalable, governed, and business-aligned data solutions.
* Support master data setup and enhancement requirements arising from business process changes and IT transformation initiatives; contribute to data migration and validation for ECC-to-S/4HANA transitions; and serve as the cross-functional liaison across business, data, and technology teams.

**What We Need To See**

* 8+ years of SAP experience with Core focus on the SAP Production Planning, Manufacturing, Material Management, and integration Knowledge with PLM systems.
* Deep understanding of maintenance and governance of complex & high-volume master data objects like Materials, BOMs, Routings, PV, and ECNs.
* At-least 1 SAP S/4 HANA implementation experience in Materials Management, Production Planning and Manufacturing.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori/UI5 interfaces used in S/4 HANA for master data maintenance apps.
* Proficiency in writing functional specifications and working with ABAP developers
* Hands-on experience developing custom enhancements (User Exits, BAdIs) and workflow logic to trigger automatic data validation and creation.
* Handle third-party system integrations with SAP using IDocs, BAPIs, and Interfaces.
* (Optional/Good-to-have) Use debugging skills to trace issues and collaborate with technical teams.
* Experience with data governance tools like SAP MDG/ Informatica (Preferred)
* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience in enterprise data architecture and data platform implementations.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and data platforms such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or Claude to improve automation, data quality, and decision-making.

NVIDIA is recognized as one of the technology world’s most sought-after employers. Our workforce includes some of the most innovative and dedicated individuals globally. If you're imaginative, driven to reach objectives, and enjoy a lively work environment, then why wait? Apply today!
  
  
Known as one of the most attractive employers in the tech industry, NVIDIA offers attractive salaries and an extensive benefits package. When planning your future, explore the opportunities accessible to both you and those close to you at www.nvidiabenefits.com/

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

**Must have skills required:**
content provenance, eval tooling, Policy engines, LLM or agent system, Docker, AWS, GCP, Azure, Python, FastAPI
  
  
**N/A is Looking for:******
**About The Founders**
We are second-time entrepreneurs and operators behind Momspresso, acquired by Honasa/Mamaearth in 2023, along with leadership experience across companies like Unilever, PepsiCo, Aviva, and WinZO.
  
  
We have worked with 300+ brands across FMCG, BFSI, DTC, healthcare, retail, and other consumer categories.
  
  
**The Role**
We're hiring an AI Platform Engineer to build and own the shared runtime our AI agents run on, and the evals that keep it honest.
  
  
We run AI agents on behalf of brands. Those agents need one gateway to the models, one place prompts get routed, and one gate that checks what is allowed before anything ships. And they need proof they work, because a brand cannot take our word for it.
  
  
Reports to the engineering lead. Individual contributor. Office in Gurugram, Monday to Friday.
  
  
**The Hard Problems**

* Build one agent runtime that new use cases plug into, without forking the code.
* Build evals strong enough to block a bad release, not just report on it.
* Run a policy gate on every generated asset, fast enough to sit in the request path.
* Keep many brands on one platform, where Brand A''s memory never reaches Brand B''s output.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Agent runtime and LLM gateway: Own one reusable platform for agent orchestration, tool execution and prompt routing, with a single path to Anthropic, OpenAI and others (caching, dedup, fallback, retries).
* Evals and release gates: Build the offline and online eval harness, golden datasets, calibrated LLM-as-judge and a CI regression gate that stops a prompt change that drops a score.
* Cost, retrieval and latency: Own inference spend per unit of output, prompt caching, and vector search over brand history (pgvector or similar) wired into the agents.
* Safety and brand isolation: Own the sandboxed policy gate, disclosure metadata and audit log on every asset, prompt-injection defence, four autonomy tiers, a kill switch and one-step rollback.
* Observability and design: Trace every agent step with OpenTelemetry so a wrong output points to the step that caused it, and own high-level and low-level design.

**What We''re Looking For**

* 3–5 years of total experience, with 2+ years in backend engineering. Python, FastAPI in production.
* Shipped an LLM or agent system to production: not a demo, not a notebook.
* Built a platform others build on: SDK, shared service or internal framework with real users.
* Built an eval harness that blocked a bad release. Tell us about the release it blocked.
* Cost or latency work you can quantify. You cut a number and you know how.
* RAG in production. Embeddings, a vector store, chunking choices you can defend.
* Cloud and CI/CD. AWS or GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Distributed systems basics. Caching, queues, idempotency, P99 latency.
* Written design docs. Led at least a small team or a large project end to end.
* Good to have: eval tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, or your own), policy engines (OPA/Rego, sandboxes), content provenance (C2PA, watermarking, EU AI Act), ad tech or martech, and side projects with agents. We read them.

**Why Join**
We''re not just building software. We''re reshaping how brands understand and scale creativity with AI. You will build the platform every agent runs on, and the measurement that proves it works.
  
  
This is an early role in a company built from the ground up. What you build becomes the foundation others build on.

title: Quantitative Researcher - Early Career (INDIA)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets.

Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams{{:}}

**Alpha Researcher{{:}}**

As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models.

**Data Scientist{{:}}**

As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models.

**Strategy Researcher{{:}}**

As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading

When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference.

**Your Responsibilities{{:}}**

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations

**Requirements**

* Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution
* Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player
* Proficient in programming languages such as Python
* Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies
* The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop
* Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Research Analyst
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose**

The CEEW’s sustainable water programme informs policy-making for the sustainable development of water resources and their effective management through research in the areas of: circular water economy for urban resilience; climate risk-informed water security planning; climate-adaptive water governance; and water accounting-based planning.

For its sustainable water programme, CEEW seeks to hire a Research Analyst with a good understanding of India’s water sector. An ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of urban water management issues and challenges, especially considering the climate variability and change, and the current policy discourse (supply and demand management, and used water treatment, recycling, and reuse) for addressing them. The candidate should have prior experience working in the used water management and circular economy sectors.

Along with a policy research orientation, the candidate should possess strong data analysis skills and support the organisation in accessing various existing secondary data sets, such as those from the Census of India, Urban Local Bodies, Central and State Pollution Control Boards, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Jal Shakti, India WRIS or any other data sets available in the public domain. The candidate should have proficiency in using statistical tools. Hands-on experience with geo-spatial tools and experience of working in projects involving the engagement of urban local bodies will be desirable.

**Job Duties and Accountabilities**

**Research:**

* Undertaking policy and data analysis for mainstreaming treated used water (TUW) reuse in local governance.
* Assist in the development of city-level TUW reuse plans.
* Conduct primary surveys, including sampling, design and questionnaire development, and undertake field visits to collect data and information related to water supply and demand across different sectors within the city or specific region.
* Analyse primary and secondary water-related datasets using statistical tools to estimate the city water balance, assess the existing used water management scenario, and identify TUW reuse avenues.
* Conduct a financial assessment using various budget estimation techniques to assess the financial viability of the proposed city-level treated used water reuse plan
* Conduct life cycle cost assessments of used water treatment technologies
* Assist in writing high-quality research reports
* Generate knowledge content – blogs, policy briefs, etc., at regular intervals

**Project Assistance:**

* Assist in preparing presentations, fact sheets, and other research communication material
* Assist team members for important meetings and sessions, prepare notes, and conduct follow-ups, as required
* Assist in coordination with the outreach team, engagement with a wider network of stakeholders, and concerned policymakers
* Travel to project sites, if required, to monitor field surveys, conduct interviews or collect data for different research projects
* Any other assistance that may be required

**Selection Criteria**

**Education and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in environmental sciences/management/planning, water resources management, urban planning/management, hydrology, public policy or a related field
* Prior experience in working with urban local bodies, used water treatment technologies and reuse solutions, and the economics of used water resource management.
* Proven evidence of conducting effective stakeholder engagement.
* 1–2 years of work experience

**Skills:**

* Competent in collecting and analysing data
* Good report writing skills
* Good data visualisation skills
* Competent in using MS Office application suite
* Proficiency in RS/GIS will be an added advantage

**Personality:**

* Willingness to learn new skills in research and project management
* Ability to adapt and deliver work under tight deadlines in a professional environment
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment

**Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate with the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

**Application Process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate based on age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Interested candidates are requested to send their applications to jobs@ceew.in with ‘Application – Research Analyst –Water’ as the subject line. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate your interest.

title: Senior Technical Consultant, India Safe Water (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here:
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
  
  
(i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water-treatment arrangements; and
  
  
(ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems
  
  
The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
  
  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan)
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution - addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet-based dozers and other chlorination options

The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
  
  
**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**

* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states

**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**

* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non-viable across different rural water-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising

**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**

* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale-up

**Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership

**Position Location**
**This is a 6-month consultancy engagement,**
with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Consultancy Fees:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

description:

**Leadership & Scale:**

* Oversee data pipelines (tick-level/L2/L3 order book data), infrastructure, and strategy monitoring systems.

**Requirements**

* **Quantitative Depth:**
  Proven mastery of option pricing models (Black-Scholes, IV surfaces), stochastic calculus, statistical arbitrage, and risk metrics (VaR, Sharpe/Sortino, max drawdown controls).
* **Hands-on Production Code:**
