You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.
* Proven architecture leadership and technical judgment across workflow orchestration, Data Operations, release management, observability, cloud infrastructure, and source-control and delivery platforms, with the ability to simplify systems and make pragmatic trade-offs.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. title: Principal Architect
description:
At S&W, we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference. As one of the UK’s top 10 fastest-growing accountancy firms, we have been a trusted partner since 1881—helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations.

Built on expertise and driven by ambition, we provide a comprehensive range of services, including tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, corporate finance, and restructuring. We are defined by our purpose—to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary.

S&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services.

The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practice IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market.

**Job Description**

**Principal Architect – AI-First IP Intelligence Platform**
  
We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert-driven workflows into an AI-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge-intensive IP workflows-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence-into modular, explainable, enterprise-grade AI systems.

* **Location:**
  Gurugram, India
* **Working format:**
  5 days per week in the office

**The Role**

You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands-on:

* AI-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
* Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them.
* Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) - a near-term critical path for this hire
* Secure, enterprise-grade Azure-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer.
* Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluation

You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company’s growth.

**Qualifications**

**Technical Strengths**

* 12-15+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
* Experience building large-scale, distributed, enterprise-grade systems
* Proven, hands-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures - frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice-to-have, for this role
* Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred

**Technical Depth**

* Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node.js or similar)
* Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
* Structured extraction from long documents; structured-output contracts with LLMs
* Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long-context model calls
* Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline design
* APIs and service design
* Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures - though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
* Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

**Domain Advantage (Preferred)**

* Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge-intensive domains
* Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
* Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high-trust environments

description:

MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments

* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role

* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

* Evaluate AI-generated outputs related to clinical workflows, health information systems, and healthcare data pipelines for accuracy and quality
* Review and assess the correctness of AI responses to health informatics prompts, flagging errors, inconsistencies, or clinically unsafe recommendations
* Prepare structured feedback, ratings, and recommendations to help AI systems learn from real-world healthcare expertise
* Apply your knowledge of clinical and operational workflows to ensure AI outputs reflect accurate, real-world practice

**Who You Are**

* Hands-on experience working with healthcare data, EHR systems, or clinical reporting platforms
* Strong analytical skills including data interpretation, trend analysis, and reporting
* Ability to assess complex health information and communicate findings clearly
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on task-based assignments
* Detail-oriented, reliable, and thorough in your evaluations

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with health data standards such as HL7, FHIR, or ICD coding
* Background in clinical informatics, health IT, or population health analytics
* Prior exposure to AI tools or machine learning workflows

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects with top-tier research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Put your specialized healthcare expertise to work in a high-impact, emerging field
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Senior Data Processing Executive
description:
**About Inizio Ignite:**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Processing Executive role will report into The Data Processing Manager position. The Data Processing Executive will be a key member of the newly formed India-based Data Processing Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets. This role is responsible for the accurate and timely production of tabulations, both interim and final, and requires close collaboration with research, project management, and scripting teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Running and validating interim and final tabulations (uncoded and coded) for quantitative research studies using relevant software (e.g., Q, Quantum, SPSS, Excel-based platforms, or proprietary tools).
* Ensuring all tabulations meet internal and client-specific formatting, logic, and output requirements.
* Checking tabulated data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before delivery.
* Supporting QA processes and documentation to maintaining high data standards across projects.
* Assisting in preparing raw datasets for processing, including basic cleaning, formatting, and consistency checks.
* Working with coded and uncoded datasets, ensuring proper integration into final tabulation outputs.
* Liaising with scripting/programming team to ensure accurate data structure for tabulation.
* Working closely with the research and project management teams to understand project requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Providing input and feedback to internal stakeholders to optimise processes and outputs.
* Managing assigned tasks within deadlines and flag any delays or data issues proactively to the manager and wider team.
* Maintaining clear documentation of tabulation processes and version control.
* Support in updating project logs and workflow tracking systems.
* Continuously improving knowledge of data processing tools, tabulation best practices, and healthcare market research processes.

**What You'll Need**

* More than 4+ years of experience in a data processing within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Basic to intermediate proficiency in data tabulation software (preferably Q, but Quantum or similar will be considered as well)
* Exposure to or understanding of survey scripting tools and survey data structures is a plus
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on data accuracy and consistency.
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.

**Ideal candidate should be**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

title: MDM Engineer - Business Partner
description:
**Position Title:**
MDM Engineer - Business Partner
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43654
  
  
We know the importance that food plays in people's lives – the power it has to bring people, families and communities together. Our purpose is to bring enjoyment to people’s lives through great tasting food, in a way which reflects our values. McCain has recently committed to implementing regenerative agriculture practices across 100 percent of our potato acreage by 2030. Ask us more about our commitment to sustainability.
  
  
**Overview**
As part of McCain digital transformation, we are making significant investments into our data structures and policies to increase the quality of our data, the confidence of our business teams to use this data to make decisions, and to drive value through the use of data.
  
  
We have an ambitious Global Data Governance team, which serves as an enabler to the business teams in our regions and global functions. We are currently recruiting an experienced Master Data Management Technical Process Engineer with strong MDG and ABAP technical understanding to support the governance and quality of Customer and Vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The MDM Technical Process Engineer will follow global processes and leverage global tools to govern data in a way that is consistent and standardized across all regions. As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, this individual will implement and maintain data governance strategies, including enforcement of policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
  
  
The position supports Business Partner Master Data Governance within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across the organization. Responsibilities include driving data quality initiatives, developing metrics and reports to monitor data integrity, performing root cause analysis of data issues, and contributing to system design improvements.
  
  
The role will also collaborate with SAP technical teams by supporting ABAP code analysis, BADI enhancements, integrations between the MDM platform and S/4 Hana, troubleshooting MDG-related logic and workflows impacting customer and vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain master data governance processes from definition through to execution and continuous improvement
* A key responsibility is configuring SimpleMDG modules for vendor and customer master (Business Partner), establishing business rules, approval workflows, and validation logic.
* Implement defined policies and frameworks specifically for vendor and customer master (Business Partner) data governance in the S/4HANA environment.
* Support the implementation of data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms
* Support the integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms with target systems like S/4 Hana, Salesforce, and the Enterprise Data Platform among others.
* Configure and support SAP MDG for Customer and Vendor Master, including data models, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.
* Perform root cause analysis of data issues and ensure remediation according to data governance policies and standards.
* Develop audit and validation methods to ensure quality of the customer and vendor master data using AI-Driven and automated approaches.
* Assist with regular compliance reviews against policies and standards.
* Identify downstream impacts of master data change.
* Ensure proper monitoring of all integrations between the MDM Platform and other systems.

**Technical & ABAP Responsibilities**

* Analyze and interpret ABAP programs, user exits, BADIs, and enhancements related to Customer master data and SAP MDG processes.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of BADIs and other extension frameworks used in MDG validation, derivation, and workflow logic.
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to analyze custom code and troubleshoot issues affecting master data governance processes.
* Perform technical analysis of SAP tables, CDS views, and data models to support data governance reporting and validation.
* Support debugging and root cause investigation of MDG workflows, rules, and integration issues impacting Customer master data.
* Work with technical teams to ensure custom developments align with MDG governance standards and best practices.
* Assist with impact analysis during system changes, upgrades, or SAP S/4HANA transformations affecting Customer master data structures

**Key Qualification & Experiences**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience with data management/governance, including but not limited to data protection and/or data quality
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, Master Data Governance (MDG) including configuration of data models, governance processes, and validations.
* Experience implementing MDM solutions in multiple organizations.
* Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including:

+ BADIs and enhancement framework
+ User exits and custom logic analysis
+ Debugging and code review
+ Understanding SAP tables and data models

* A certification like MDG100 will enhance the candite profile.
* Preferred: Experience working with PIM, Data Catalog, Data Governance, and MDM systems.
* Preferred: Understanding of CPG industry specifics — product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements.
* Experience harmonizing systems, processes, and/or data across business areas and functions
* Experience working on an agile team in a virtual, distributed environment

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and participate as an independent contributor with little supervision

We recognize that inclusion drives our creativity, resilience, and success and makes our business stronger. title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

  

**Qualification**
**Education**
 Required 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required

Preferred

* Master’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred

  

**Experience**
 Required

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Required

* Experience with:
  + Salesforce / CRM
  + Advanced SQL
  + Advanced Alteryx
  + Python / ML

+ AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI

* Data Analysis

+ Data Research
+ Data Integrity
+ Data Visualization
+ Automation
+ Project Management
+ Team Leadership

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint

  

Preferred

* Experience with:

* ServiceNow
* Coaching
* Mentoring
* Training
* Advanced Tableau
* Helpdesk support (email, live user training)

title: Quantitative Researcher - Experienced Hires (India)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 

As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research.

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis

**Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

description:

Cosentus is looking for a

.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can independently design complex systems, develop application modules, integrate modern AI technologies, and take complete ownership from architecture through production.

  .

  **High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD)**

  **asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, queues, caching, and parallel execution**
  .

  **AWS Lambda-based services**
  and integrate AI models using
  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .

  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .
* Design scalable APIs, database schemas, background processing workflows, and communication between microservices.

  **concurrency controls, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, and monitoring**
  .
* Integrate
  **AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
  where required.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend services, databases, AI models, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of
  **development, deployment, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting**
  .

Core Technical Skills1. Full Stack Development & System Design

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**

description:

* Define the target payments architecture and lead the UPI switch recommendation.

**Common Data Foundation**

**Cross-business Architecture Leadership**

* Partner with product, engineering, risk, security, compliance and operations leaders.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Clear, approved direction for the UPI switch and target payments architecture.
* Adoption of a governed common data layer across priority journeys.
* Reusable AI capabilities that improve service while protecting customer data and controls.

title: Associate, Data Engineer Workplace Data & Insights
description:
**About This Role**
Your Team:
  
  
Enterprise Services provides strategic workplace solutions and robust infrastructure to deliver a consistent employee experience globally. Our team spans real estate strategy, workplace operations and facilities management, risk and resilience, corporate security and executive operations, and workplace experience and insights.
  
  
**Your Role And Impact**
Your role will shape the trusted data foundations and analytical products that support both Enterprise Services and Digital Workplace. Working closely with a pipeline engineer, you will understand workplace data requirements, help translate source data into reliable analytical models and reports, and turn data from our physical workplaces and digital employee environment into actionable insights. You will focus on building effective dashboards, reports and the underlying datasets which can be accessed through self-service and via AI tools. Your efforts will enable dependable reporting, self-service analytics and actionable insight into how we operate globally for nearly 30,000 employees.
  
  
**As a Data Engineer, You Will**

* Develop and optimize trusted data models and shared semantic models that standardize core entities, dimensions and metrics across physical and digital workplace reporting.
* Create and maintain Power BI datasets, dashboards, reports and analytical tools that enable leaders and operational teams to understand employee experience, technology performance, space utilization and workplace operations.
* Enable secure self-service analytics and responsible data use through reusable datasets, clear documentation and appropriate access controls, aligned with privacy, audit and InfoSec standards.
* Implement data quality, lineage, testing and observability controls, investigating issues and working with source-system owners to resolve root causes.
* Define, develop and maintain automated, monitored and well-documented analytical transformations and reporting processes, partnering with the pipeline engineer on upstream dependencies to improve reliability, refresh performance and time from source data to decision-ready insight.
* Partner with a pipeline engineer to define data ingestion, integration and transformation requirements across digital workplace platforms, workplace technology, occupancy and space systems, facilities and operational sources.
* Partner with product managers, analysts, technology teams and workplace stakeholders to translate business questions into clear technical requirements and reliable data solutions.

**What You'll Need**

* 3–6 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering or a related discipline, including delivery of production-grade data and reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and design principles to create clear, engaging insights that communicate the story, highlight what matters and support decision-making.
* Strong SQL skills and practical experience designing, querying and optimizing relational, dimensional and analytical data models.
* Experience partnering with data or pipeline engineers to specify source, ingestion, transformation and integration needs across APIs, files, databases and cloud platforms, and to validate that resulting datasets meet analytical requirements.
* Experience developing Power BI semantic models, reports and dashboards, including Power Query and performance optimization.
* Understanding of software engineering practices including version control, testing, deployment, monitoring and technical documentation.
* Ability to analyze complex datasets, identify quality issues and trends, and explain technical findings clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to gather requirements and deliver maintainable solutions that support business outcomes.

**Technical Knowledge Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services and related Microsoft analytics tooling.
* Experience with Python or another scripting language for data transformation, automation and quality validation.
* Knowledge of workplace data domains such as Microsoft 365 and endpoint experience, service management, occupancy, space, building, facilities or employee experience data.
* Familiarity with metadata management, data catalogs, master and reference data, privacy, security and role-based access controls.
* Understanding of APIs, workflow orchestration, CI/CD and modern cloud data architecture patterns.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Data Engineer / BI Analyst at Kriya, you'll own the flow of data from our source systems through to the reports and insights the business relies on every day. You'll build and maintain the pipelines that bring data together, model it in Power BI so teams can self-serve, and work directly with stakeholders to turn business questions into datasets and reports they can trust.
  
  
This is a broad, hands-on role spanning both data engineering and BI, with a high degree of autonomy. You'll also own key recurring data processes end-to-end and the tooling behind them (Power BI, Synapse Analytics). The role includes building Power BI semantic models and reports, but it is not primarily a business-insights or analyst position. Success means reliable pipelines, trustworthy curated data, maintainable semantic models, safe releases, and effective production support. Insights and analytics are a plus.
  
  
A key part of the role is making data accessible through AI, enabling business users to ask questions of our data in natural language, so trusted answers aren't gated behind a report request or a SQL query.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Deliver trusted, analysis-ready data. Own the data flow from source systems to the reports the business relies on, so decisions are made on data people can trust.
* Keep the data platform running. Keep extraction, transformation, feeds and scheduled reports flowing reliably - "keep the lights on" for data.
* Support data-driven decisions with BI models, reports, and dashboards.
* Enable business users to self-serve through training and knowledge sharing. Make data available via AI so users can ask questions about data in natural language.

**Detailed**

* Data engineering: design, implement, and optimise data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL/ELT) data from multiple sources, ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Data quality and integrity: implement best practices for data validation, cleansing, and governance to guarantee high-quality, consistent, and reliable datasets.
* Data delivery: work directly with business stakeholders to scope and build bespoke datasets and reports supporting business decisions. Maintain data dictionaries, pipelines and delivery methods (SFTP feeds, Google Sheets integrations, etc).
* Data modelling (BI): Design and maintain the semantic layer in Power BI so business users can self-serve reliably. Ensure models are well-documented and consistent.
* Process ownership: Own end-to-end recurring data processes, like CAIS, DCM, data tapes. You will be working directly with internal and external stakeholders.
* Tool ownership: Own the data tooling end-to-end (Power BI, Synapse Analytics): configuration, security, access, maintenance, upgrades and user enablement/training.
* Maintenance: ensure observability, resolve problems, alerts, incidents and BAU requests

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Fluent in English
* Ability to work UK working hours
* 5+ years of experience as DE/BI
* solid SQL, Azure Synapse (or Azure Data Factory), PowerBI skills
* Python, Google Cloud Platform, Looker are nice to have
* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) where audit trails and data accuracy have compliance implications and some reports are deadline-sensitive.

**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
  
  
**Flexible working**
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
  
  
**Diversity**
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

Consultancy
