title: Data Engineer - MS Fabric & Azure
description:
As a Senior Data Engineer in the GDC Marketing Services team at VML, you will design, build, and own end-to-end data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure that power marketing, sales, and website performance reporting for Microsoft across Asia, EMEA, and the Americas. You will architect OneLake-based Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions following a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) pattern to deliver curated, analytics-ready datasets, and lead the migration of legacy SQL Server, SSIS, and SSAS workloads to Microsoft Fabric with minimal disruption to business reporting. Working across our Delhi and Buenos Aires hubs, you will act as the technical lead and mentor for data engineering across the global team.

**What will you do?**

* Design, build, and own end-to-end data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure that power marketing, sales, and website performance reporting across Asia, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Architect OneLake-based Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions following a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) pattern on Delta tables to deliver curated, analytics-ready datasets.
* Develop and orchestrate scalable batch and incremental ingestion pipelines using Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, and Azure Data Factory.
* Integrate marketing and sales data sources including Adobe Analytics, Dynamics 365/Dataverse, marketing automation platforms, SQL Server, SharePoint, and third-party REST APIs into a unified data platform.
* Build and optimize Direct Lake, Import, and composite semantic models in partnership with BI developers to support the Power BI dashboard portfolio.
* Lead the migration of legacy SQL Server, SSIS, and SSAS workloads to Microsoft Fabric with minimal disruption to business reporting.
* Implement automated data quality checks, validation rules, and reconciliation controls to safeguard data accuracy across all pipelines.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune pipeline performance, workloads, and Fabric capacity consumption to ensure reliability and cost efficiency.
* Enforce data security, privacy, and governance standards, including access controls, PII handling, sensitivity labels, and lineage through Microsoft Purview.
* Define and maintain engineering standards, reusable frameworks, data contracts, and technical documentation for the data platform.
* Mentor analysts and junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and act as the technical point of contact for data engineering across the global team.
* Partner with Microsoft stakeholders, BI leads, and platform teams to translate reporting requirements into scalable data architecture and delivery roadmaps.

**What will you need?**

**Microsoft Fabric**

* Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks.
* Experience with OneLake shortcuts and Fabric Mirroring to integrate data from Azure SQL, ADLS Gen2, Dataverse, and other sources without duplication.
* Experience with Fabric capacity management, Capacity Metrics monitoring, workload governance, and workspace administration.
* Proficiency with Fabric deployment pipelines and Git integration for source-controlled, multi-environment releases.

**Azure Data Platform**

* Strong experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Azure Synapse Analytics pipelines, including parameterization, triggers, and integration runtimes.
* Solid knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, storage design, and file formats such as Parquet, Delta, CSV, and JSON.

**SQL & Data Modeling**

* Advanced T-SQL expertise on SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Fabric Warehouse, including stored procedures, query tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Experience with SSIS packages and SSAS tabular models, including migration of these legacy workloads to Microsoft Fabric.
* Strong dimensional modeling skills including star schema design, slowly changing dimensions, and fact table design optimized for Power BI consumption.

**Power BI**

* Experience designing Power BI semantic models in Direct Lake, Import, and composite modes, including row-level security and working knowledge of DAX.

**Source Integrations**

* Experience ingesting Adobe Analytics data via Data Feeds and APIs and modeling web and campaign performance data.
* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 and Dataverse data, including linking to Microsoft Fabric, for sales pipeline and CRM reporting.

**Security & Governance**

* Strong understanding of Azure security, including Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview for data cataloging, lineage, classification, and sensitivity labels.

**Programming**

* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with working knowledge of KQL and PowerShell for querying and automation.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of marketing and sales data domains, including campaign, web analytics, lead, and opportunity pipeline data.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership and accountability for platform reliability, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data issues.
* Ability to translate business and reporting requirements from marketing and sales stakeholders into clear technical designs.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills within complex, multi-source data environments.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the global team.
* Mentorship mindset with the ability to coach analysts and junior engineers through code reviews and pairing.
* Effective collaboration across distributed, cross-functional teams and time zones, including the Buenos Aires and Delhi hubs.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent engineering deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
* Continuous learning mindset with curiosity for evolving Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and AI capabilities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, including at least 3 years building solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric.
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade data pipelines and Lakehouse/Warehouse solutions on the Microsoft data stack.

title: Scientific Computing / Research Engineering Expert — Earth Sciences
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking experienced Earth Sciences experts to develop realistic, terminal-based scientific and computational tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will design challenging scientific tasks involving climate science, atmospheric processes, geophysics, oceanography, geology, hydrology, remote sensing, and environmental modeling. You will build reproducible computational workflows that require AI agents to analyze scientific datasets, execute code, run simulations, troubleshoot technical issues, and generate objectively verifiable scientific outputs.

**What you'll do:**

* Design realistic, multi-step scientific tasks based on authentic Earth Sciences, climate, geospatial, environmental, and geophysical research workflows.
* Prepare and process scientific datasets involving climate, weather, atmospheric conditions, oceanography, geology, hydrology, satellite imagery, and environmental systems.
* Develop computational tasks involving geospatial analysis, time-series processing, numerical modeling, interpolation, forecasting, remote sensing, and environmental risk analysis.
* Build reproducible, terminal-based computational environments using scientific libraries, command-line tools, and appropriate dependencies.
* Develop expert reference solutions using Python, R, Bash, Julia, or domain-specific scientific software.
* Create automated tests and evaluation criteria to verify scientific correctness, numerical accuracy, spatial and temporal consistency, and reproducibility.
* Validate coordinate reference systems, measurement units, timestamps, missing-data handling, uncertainty, and scientific assumptions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues involving geospatial projections, large scientific datasets, software dependencies, computational performance, and numerical stability.
* Ensure tasks require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning and cannot be solved through simple shortcuts or hard-coded outputs.
* Document dataset sources, computational workflows, expected outputs, edge cases, and scientific limitations.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Earth Sciences, Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Oceanography, Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, Bash, Julia, or another relevant scientific programming language.
* Hands-on experience working in Linux and terminal-based computational environments.
* Practical expertise in at least one major area: scientific data processing, numerical modeling, geospatial analysis, climate modeling, remote sensing, or environmental data analysis.
* Strong understanding of spatial datasets, time-series analysis, scientific modeling, numerical accuracy, uncertainty, and data quality control.
* Experience working with real-world scientific datasets, including geospatial, climate, atmospheric, oceanographic, geological, or hydrological data.
* Ability to independently develop, execute, debug, and validate reproducible scientific computational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify scientific inaccuracies, data inconsistencies, and computational errors.
* Ability to design objective validation methods and clearly document technical solutions and scientific assumptions.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with scientific computing and geospatial libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, xarray, rasterio, GeoPandas, Cartopy, GDAL, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF, HDF5, GeoTIFF, shapefiles, GRIB, and other geospatial or environmental data formats.
* Experience working with climate, weather, oceanographic, seismic, satellite, hydrological, or geological datasets.
* Familiarity with Docker, Conda, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience using high-performance computing (HPC) environments or processing large-scale scientific datasets.
* Experience with Earth-system models, environmental forecasting, remote sensing applications, or geophysical simulations.
* Research software engineering experience, including developing scientific tools, simulation pipelines, or reproducible research workflows.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, scientific benchmarks, or automated grading systems.
* Publications, research contributions, or open-source development experience in Earth or Environmental Sciences.
* Prior experience in AI training, scientific quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed

* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

improving well beyond launchSharpen where Evidence Action's own evidence generation is uniquely valuable versus where other partners are better placedOwn independent quality assuranceUnderstand how modelingDesign and implement the systems that let us review evidence consistently across our portfolio, including program stage gates and structured evidence and programmatic reviews at key decision pointsOwn data quality assurance so it is structurally independent from evidence generation, setting methodology standards, commissioning re-surveys and integrity checks, and surfacing issues early and transparentlyProvide evidence-based recommendations that inform program scale-up, ongoing iteration, and wind-down decisions, holding a strong voice in those decisions while partnering with program and regional leaders who bring essential local contextStrengthen technical capability and relieve program teamsBuild internal technical management capacity that benefit our programsLead a multi-disciplinary function through consolidation and change, building trust across MLE, cost-effectiveness, and epidemiology teams and bringing our people along through a significant transitionIdentify where AI and modern data tools can strengthen evidence generation and decision-making at scaleRepresent Evidence Action externallyServe as a senior organizational voice on evidence, engaging donors, the board, and technical partners on our evidence philosophy, methodological choices, and standing evaluation arrangementsChampion a transparent culture that shares learning; including learning from what does not work, both inside the organization and with the relevant external stakeholdersWho You AreWe are looking for a leader with rigorous technical training who has title: Global Data Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integrations that support BCG’s Marketing function. You will work across cloud-based platforms, external APIs, and diverse data sources to ensure reliable, high-quality data is available for analysis and decision-making.
  
  
You will take ownership of complex data engineering tasks, troubleshoot production issues, improve data models and code efficiency, and help maintain strong standards for data quality, security, testing, and documentation.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Design, build, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integrations.
* Integrate data from cloud platforms, on-premises systems, and external APIs.
* Manage and improve data platform processes to support reliable production delivery.
* Investigate data issues, resolve discrepancies, and address root causes.
* Monitor pipeline performance and help ensure agreed service levels are met.
* Improve data models, code efficiency, testing, and overall data quality.
* Apply strong standards for data integrity, security, and technical documentation.
* Stay current with evolving data engineering tools, platforms, and approaches

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 4–6 years of relevant experience in data engineering.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python for data pipelines and API integrations.
* Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
* Working knowledge of version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, or Terraform.
* Strong analytical problem solving, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve data issues.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of the Data Hub Squad, focused on ingesting, transforming, streamlining, and exposing high-quality data to support BCG’s Marketing function. You will work closely with the Chapter Lead, Product Owner, other data engineers, analysts, and teams across the Marketing Portfolio.
  
  
The role is highly collaborative, with regular interaction across technical and non-technical teams to help ensure data solutions are reliable, useful, and aligned with business needs
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!

title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations
  
  

* Architectural Leadership: Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for the data migration engine and its surrounding ecosystem. Contribute core, foundational code that solves the hardest scalability problems and sets the standard for the rest of the team
* Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Design to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives
* Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

Success Measures
  
  
Within the first three months, you will have:
  
  

* Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
* Familiarise yourself with the problem space and the domain
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews

Within six months, you will have:
  
  

* Worked on and delivered a large-scale code analysis feature in the product
* Contributed to and helped deliver a few releases of the product
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered large-scale features across our entire tech stack
* Helped recruit, interview and mentor new members of the team
* Collaborated with other teams at MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**Role Scope**
Data Steward is an individual contributor role responsible for executing core data stewardship activities that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of enterprise data assets. The Data Steward manages end‑to‑end lineage monitoring, maintains high‑quality metadata, enforces policy and control compliance, and supports UAT for database changes and product distribution. Within the European Gas and Power Data team, the role supports the controlled transition of source data into internal databases and downstream delivery pipelines, ensuring raw data is validated, reconciled, transformed, and quality checked before it is made available to internal SMEs and external clients. The role performs detailed data validation, vendor data reviews, and works closely with Technology and Data Operations teams to resolve issues and maintain consistent data standards across systems.
  
  
Additionally, the Data Steward contributes to process improvement by driving standardization, enhancing documentation, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are looking for a process-orientated, methodological thinker with a keen eye for detail. Someone who enjoys dealing with large sets of data and problem solving.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Perform data validation checks, lineage tracking, and metadata updates to maintain data quality, integrity, and traceability.
* Execute data ingestion, validation, and integration activities in alignment with governance and control standards.
* Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise data policies and governance frameworks.
* Execute defined controls and compliance requirements to safeguard data integrity and lineage.
* Support vendor data reviews and onboarding through data quality assessments, validation checks, and issue resolution.
* Maintain data standardization, stewardship documentation, and process artifacts to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Execute medium‑complexity stewardship and validation tasks under established guidelines, escalating exceptions when required.
* Respond to client data queries, resolving issues and coordinating issue triage with Operations and Client Services teams.
* Collaborate with Technology teams on defect resolution, enhancement requests, and UAT for backend data and dataflow changes.
* Contribute to automation and AI‑enabled improvements that enhance efficiency and strengthen stewardship capabilities.
* Investigate, validate, troubleshoot, and support controlled updates to transformation scripts, data quality rules, and pipeline logic using Python, SQL and PySpark, ensuring automated processes continue to run to schedule producing accurate outputs.
* Support onboarding of new datasets required by SMEs by reviewing source structures, validating expected outputs, identifying data quality risks, and coordinating required pipeline or source data changes within the existing architecture.

**Process Excellence**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data, coordinating test execution, and assisting with defect identification and resolution.
* Ensure adherence to governance, data management standards, and operating procedures by following defined controls and compliance requirements.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation by updating process flows, data definitions, data dictionaries, and other stewardship artifacts to ensure audit readiness and operational clarity.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Data Operations and Technology teams to support governance activities, quality controls, source amendments, validation outcomes and issue remediation while serving as a key liaison between governance expectations and day‑to‑day execution
* Support Product and Technology teams by assisting with data requirements, validations, and operational coordination throughout change cycles.
* Assist with vendor data reviews by conducting data quality checks, performing validations, and coordinating onboarding processes.

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Data accuracy and integrity - Maintain high accuracy rates through consistent validation, timely corrections, and adherence to defined quality thresholds.
* SLA and turnaround adherence - Meet or exceed service‑level timelines for data updates, validations, issue resolution, and stakeholder responses.
* Documentation completeness and currency - Keep process documentation, data dictionaries, lineage records, and stewardship artifacts up‑to‑date, audit‑ready, and fully aligned with governance standards.
* Pipeline quality and delivery - Ensure transformation scripts, database workflows, quality checks, and scheduled processes run successfully, with failures investigated, validated, resolved, or coordinated through to closure in line with operational priorities.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**
**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate Python scripting skills, including the ability to investigate, maintain, debug, and support controlled updates to transformation logic, automation scripts, and data quality checks.
* Intermediate SQL capability to query, reconcile, transform, validate, and troubleshoot data across relational databases and pipeline outputs.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark or distributed data processing to support investigation, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and pipeline monitoring, would be advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows.
* Works with metadata management and lineage tools to maintain data transparency and trace end‑to‑end data flows.
* Possess foundational familiarity with BI tools and dashboards to review outputs and identify data anomalies.

**Functional Skills**

* Possesses solid domain and process understanding
* Understands data governance fundamentals, including data quality controls, stewardship roles, and ownership models.
* Supports data standardization by applying consistent data definitions, formats, and controlled processes.
* Has working knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and integration workflows, with the ability to investigate pipeline failures, check source-to-target accuracy, support root cause resolution, and coordinate remediation actions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data requirements/issues and generate innovative ideas and solutions.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data, documentation, and validation activities, functional teams cause analysis.
* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with cross functional teams including Technology, Operations, Product, and Vendor partners.
* Applies analytical mindset, critical thinking & creative problem solving to build solutions for business problems and while investigating data issues and remediation through root cause analysis.
* Demonstrates learning agility, digital acumen, initiative, and ownership in data stewardship activities, adapting to evolving tools and technologies while working effectively through ambiguity to investigate issues, and support timely delivery against operational priorities.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in data, analytics, operations, or related functions.

**Key Interfaces & Stakeholders**

* Partner with Data Operations and SMEs on data risk, quality checks, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate with Tech teams on data issues, enhancements, and UAT activities.
* Support Product teams with data requirements and validation.
* Ensure alignment with governance and compliance standards.

**What’s In It For**
**You?**
**Our Mission**
Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you are part of the Data Platform Engineering team, helping customers make smart, well informed decisions by harnessing diverse, well curated healthcare data at scale. You design and build full stack solutions that support data driven products and platform capabilities across modern cloud environments. In this role, you contribute to responsive user experiences, scalable backend services, and distributed systems that support the performance, reliability, and security of Inovalon’s data platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, deploy, test, and support technical solutions using full stack development tools and technologies.
* Build user friendly, responsive web interfaces using modern web application frameworks and front end technologies.
* Develop backend services and application logic using Java, SQL, and Python, and build front end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Design and implement solutions using relational and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on scalable data access and performance.
* Deploy microservices using container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with AWS managed services and related cloud tools.
* Troubleshoot complex distributed systems and resolve application and performance issues across the platform.
* Contribute to secure web application development by applying best practices in software design, implementation, and deployment.
* Support CI and CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques to improve software delivery and release reliability.
* Collaborate effectively with team members in a fast paced agile environment to deliver scalable platform solutions.
* Stay current with trends and technologies in backend and front end development and apply relevant improvements to engineering work.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Java development, and 3+ years of experience with JavaScript using modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
* Bachelor of Technology, Master of Technology, Bachelor of Engineering, Master of Sciences, or Master of Computer Applications, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong experience with Java, SQL, Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Expert level knowledge of RDBMS, SQL, and NoSQL database technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with caching, queuing, scheduling, concurrency, and event driven architectures.
* Demonstrated experience developing applications on or for Linux platforms.
* Proven track record implementing distributed systems, microservice architectures, and RESTful APIs.
* Strong experience with AWS preferred, and experience with Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques.
* Knowledge of best practices for implementing secure web applications.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by staying current with emerging backend, front end, cloud, and platform technologies, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross functional partners, contributing technical expertise in agile environments, and helping move complex platform work forward across the team.
* Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to evolving requirements, changing priorities, and the demands of fast paced platform development.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical solutions to distributed systems challenges, performance issues, and full stack design problems.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by troubleshooting complex technical issues, evaluating system behavior, and using evidence to make sound engineering decisions.
* Nice to have: Experience in data pipelines; experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake and Datastax.

Our Shared Commitments
  
  

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

Work Environment
  
  

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
The Commercial Excellence CoE is a pivotal function within A&M’s broader global Commercial Excellence practice, serving as the GCC-based hub and Supports Pricing, Sales effectiveness, Customer retention & renewals and other commercial excellence topics working closely with our U.S-based team across both B2C and B2B businesses. Our team plays a critical role in consolidating and scaling A&M’s Commercial Excellence capabilities bringing analytical rigor, commercial insight, and operational know-how to help clients unlock measurable margin improvement. As part of our firm’s continued investment in building out a full spectrum Commercial Excellence offering, the CoE acts as both a capability enabler and innovation engine developing reusable methodologies, diagnostic tools, and accelerators that support pricing transformation initiatives across industries and markets. Joining our team means being at the forefront of Commercial Excellence analytics and strategy, working closely with global teams to deliver high-impact outcomes in an area that is increasingly core to our clients' commercial success.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Product Development & Innovation (Agentic AI for Commercial Excellence)
* Lead the design and development of agentic AI workflows across key Commercial Excellence levers (pricing, churn, revenue analytics, salesforce effectiveness)
* Translate business problems into AI-enabled solution architectures, including:
* Multi-agent systems for decisioning (e.g., pricing recommendations, churn interventions)
* LLM-powered in sight generation and narrative synthesis
* Conversational AI interfaces for tools (e.g., chatbot-driven analytics navigation)
* Build and scale modular, reusable AI accelerators and assets (e.g., Commercial Excellence AI modules, insight engines, recommendation agents)
* Define product roadmap for the AI-enabled Commercial Excellence platform, including integration with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes)
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure scalable, production-grade deployment architectures (APIs, microservices, cloud platforms)
* Continuously optimize systems for performance, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency
* Generative AI & Agentic Systems
* Architect and govern scalable, reusable agentic AI frameworks for enterprise use cases
* Define orchestration and execution patterns for multi-agent systems (event-driven workflows, planning/reflection loops)
* Develop reusable agent templates, blueprints, and context frameworks to accelerate deployment across Commercial Excellence use cases
* Evaluate solution design trade-offs across business value, data readiness, model performance, and cost
* Drive the development of PoCs, MVPs, and production-grade solutions, ensuring smooth transition from experimentation to scaled deployment
* Determine optimal use of LLMs vs traditional ML / rules-based approaches based on use case requirements
* Model Lifecycle, Quality, Cost & Risk Management
* Establish and govern MLOps / LLMOps frameworks, including model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
* Define and implement CI/CD pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and retraining workflows
* Optimize key components such as retrieval strategies, embeddings, prompting, grounding, and caching
* Drive improvements in model accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost efficiency, while minimizing hallucinations
* Implement frameworks for model evaluation, explainability, and robustness
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in consulting, analytics, AI/ML, or product-led environments, ideally with exposure to Commercial Excellence / Revenue Growth / Pricing domains
* Proven experience building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions in real world applications
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
* Experience developing LLM-based applications, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Insight generation and summarization; Conversational interface
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and ML/AI libraries (e.g., Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch)
* Experience with API development (FastAPI/Flask) and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Understanding of multi-agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, and planning paradigms
* Familiarity with data pipelines, model deployment, and productizing considerations
* Strong understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, APIs, and cloud-native architectures
* Experience with foundational models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock)
* Proven experience delivering AI-powered SaaS or internal platforms to automate workflows and enhance customer experience
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align AI strategy with enterprise goals
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with adaptability to the rapidly evolving AI landscap
* Commercial Excellence & Business Acumen - Strong understanding of Commercial Excellence concepts, including, but not limited to: Pricing and margin optimization; Customer segmentation and churn; Revenue analytics and growth strategy; Salesforce effectiveness; Ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions
* Experience in data-driven problem solving and executive storytelling
* Experience working with senior stakeholders to shape commercial strategy and drive adoption, including leading workshops, influencing decision-making, and aligning cross functional teams (sales, finance, product)
* Ability to develop clear, compelling executive storylines, distilling complex analyses and AI outputs into concise recommendations for C-suite audiences
* Support managers and senior team members in delivering AI-enabled Commercial Excellence projects across product development, PoCs, demos, and client delivery
* Take ownership of defined work modules, including analysis, data preparation, model testing, workflow configuration, documentation, and output quality checks
* Work comfortably in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, showing curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new AI tools and commercial concepts
* Communicate progress, issues, and findings clearly to internal teams; proactively escalate risks or dependencies where required

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Operational Excellence
description:
**Overview**
The Operational Excellence role will support the Sales Operations, Planning and Enablement functions within BSO, strengthening how we use data, technology and AI to drive better business decisions and execution.The role will bring together business analytics, data visualisation, scenario modelling and tooling to turn complex business information into clear, actionable insights. It will support BSO and Area teams in evaluating options and making informed decisions across areas such as fiscal year Planning, Fast Start, Segmentation, Territory design, Resource allocation. The role will also identify opportunities to simplify and improve how we work through AI, automation and fit-for-purpose tools, building scalable capabilities that improve productivity and enable more effective execution across the organisation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Data-driven decision support: Analyse large and complex datasets and translate them into clear, practical insights that enable BSO and Area leaders to make better-informed planning and operational decisions.
* Data visualisation & Power BI: Design and build intuitive Power BI dashboards, analytical views and visualisations that surface the key trends, outliers, risks and opportunities behind the data, rather than simply reporting metrics.
* Area insights: Develop clear, relevant Area/Subsidiary -level views and insights that enable Areas to understand their business, identify where action is required and make informed decisions.
* Scenario modelling: Build analytical models and tools that allow teams to test different scenarios and understand the potential impact of decisions across segmentation, territories, resource allocation and other planning choices.
* Fast Start enablement: Develop the analytical and modelling capabilities required to support Fast Start, giving BSO and Area teams clear visibility to support planning decisions and execution.
* Enablement tooling: Develop and improve tools and digital capabilities that enable programmes and content to scale effectively across the organisation.
* AI & automation: Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, Copilot and automation to simplify processes, improve the way data is consumed and reduce manual effort..

* Demonstrated experience working with large and complex datasets, with the ability to structure, analyse and interpret data effectively.
* Advanced Power BI and Excel capability, including data modelling, visualisation, dashboards and scenario analysis.Strong ability to turn complex datasets into simple insights, visualisations and recommendations for business audiences.
* Proven ability to identify trends, outliers, patterns and opportunities within data.Experience building practical analytical tools and solutions to support business planning and decision-making.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, highly matrixed environment, connecting multiple stakeholders, priorities, processes and data sources.
* Understanding of BSO processes and sales planning disciplines and how they come together to support field execution would be an advantage

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Philip Morris India is hiring for Data Engineer.
  
  
The Data Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for designing, building and maintaining scalable data platforms, pipelines and data products that enable reliable, secure and high-quality data for analytics, reporting and AI use cases. The role plays a critical part in establishing strong data foundations across the enterprise by developing robust ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data pipelines and ensuring data quality, governance and performance across platforms such as Snowflake and AWS.
  
  
The position bridges business requirements with technical implementation by translating data needs into efficient, production-grade data solutions that support business intelligence, advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and tools such as Matillion, Airflow or dbt to ingest, transform and load data into enterprise data platforms.
* Develop and optimize data models, tables and transformation logic in Snowflake to support analytics, reporting and downstream data consumption use cases.
* Ensure efficient data ingestion and integration across multiple source systems by managing ingestion frameworks and enabling standardized data pipelines.
* Implement data quality, validation, monitoring and recovery mechanisms to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability of data across pipelines and data products.
* Optimize query performance, data storage and processing efficiency through advanced SQL techniques, partitioning, indexing strategies and workload optimization.
* Collaborate with Data Analysts, IT and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions supporting BI, analytics and AI use cases.
* Define and enforce data governance policies including data security, access control, masking and lifecycle management within data platforms.
* Support development of data products and AI/ML pipelines by enabling curated, high-quality datasets and feature-ready data layers for advanced analytics and GenAI use cases.

Educational Requirement : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems or related technical field.
  
  
Work experince required : 8-10 years of experience in data engineering, data platform development or related roles, with hands-on ownership of data pipelines and data infrastructure.
  
  
Experience working in cloud-based data environments and enterprise-scale data platforms.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Role And Impact**
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Topsoe’s digital transformation and supporting our strategic vision to become a global leader in carbon emission reduction technologies. You will join a dynamic digitalization team comprised of Data Engineers, Internet of Things (IoT) experts, Data Scientists, Front End Developers, and Business Developers, all working together to develop innovative digital solutions and optimize business processes. Your work will directly influence both strategic and operational analytics initiatives, collaborating closely with subject matter experts to build a scalable platform that underpins Topsoe’s analytical capabilities and digital product development.
  
  
You will be involved throughout the entire product development lifecycle, working hand-in-hand with Data Scientists and Business Development Leads to deliver impactful digital services and products.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Designing and developing robust data pipelines for batch and streaming data using Microsoft Azure Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings.
* Acting as a subject matter expert in data engineering, driving the delivery of digital services and products.
* Ensuring the availability of infrastructure, tools, and procedures to support the digitalization roadmap and empower end-users.
* Facilitating data-driven decision-making across the organization by combining technical expertise with business acumen.

**What You Will Bring**
You bring a strong foundation as a modern cloud data engineer or architect, with a passion for analytics and innovation. Your expertise includes hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure stack—such as Databricks, Data Lake, Event Hub, and SQL Server—and proficiency in Python or PySpark development. You are solution-oriented, efficient, and structured, with a curiosity that drives you to challenge the status quo and share knowledge. You thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, taking ownership of complex projects and collaborating with multiple stakeholders. Key qualifications include:
  
  

* Academic background in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (M.Sc., M.Tech, or B.Tech).
* Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark.
* Familiarity with setting up and managing DevOps pipelines.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as ARM, Bicep, or Terraform is a plus.
* Knowledge of data management, business intelligence architecture, and dashboard creation is advantageous.
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

**Why Join Us**
At Topsoe, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of digital solutions in a company committed to sustainability and innovation. We offer an engaging and inclusive work environment where your ideas and expertise are valued. You will be part of a forward-thinking team, working on impactful projects that drive real change in the energy sector. We support your professional growth through continuous learning, career development opportunities, and exposure to cutting-edge technologies. Join us to make a meaningful contribution to a global leader in energy transition and enjoy a workplace that values diversity, collaboration, and shared success.
  
  
**Your New Team**
You will join a highly skilled and collaborative digitalization team, currently consisting of three Data Engineers in Denmark and three in India, alongside IoT experts, Data Scientists, Front End Developers, and Business Developers. The team is known for its high level of professional competence, mutual respect, and an open, innovative work environment. You will work closely with subject matter experts and other digital professionals, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement.
  
  
**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
Application deadline: 23-10-2026.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Technical Chief of Staff
description:
**About Castler**

Castler provides compliance-grade trust infrastructure for both money and software. We help enterprises and financial institutions govern mission-critical assets through independent, rules-based escrow frameworks, so that financial flows and software dependencies are not left solely in the hands of a counterparty. Built on bank-grade security standards, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, we are trusted by technology and risk teams across the country. Castler is backed by Flipkart, Capital 2B (an Info Edge fund), Zerodha, IIFL Ventures, and Stride Ventures, and has been recognised at the NASSCOM Fintech Awards, MINT Startup Awards, and IAMAI Digital Awards.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Technical Chief of Staff who works alongside leadership to drive our most important priorities and owns processes end to end, from building on our product tech stack to architecting and optimising our go-to-market motion. This role sits at the intersection of technology, revenue, operations, and execution. Your job is to build scalable systems that turn our Ideal Customer Profile into predictable revenue. It is a hands-on engineering role as much as a strategic one; you will write code and present to leadership in the same week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and orchestrate end-to-end buyer journeys, from ICP identification through to revenue conversion.
* Build and optimise multi-channel GTM experiments using AI tools and platforms.
* Develop data-driven strategies to identify, engage, and convert high-value accounts.
* Build automated workflows and systems that scale revenue operations, integrating GTM tools with our core product and data.
* Partner with the leadership team to drive key projects and strategy initiatives from planning through execution.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimise the full revenue funnel.
* Evaluate and implement new GTM technologies to keep our edge.
* Own daily, weekly, and monthly business reporting so decisions stay data-driven.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and build AI-based solutions to streamline workflows.
* Scope, build, ship, and maintain internal tools, integrations, and automations on our product stack (Node.js, Python, React.js).
* Build AI-powered solutions using OpenAI APIs and Claude Code to accelerate engineering, operations, and GTM.
* Act as the bridge between engineering, product, and business, translating priorities into technical execution.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with exposure to AI-driven operations, automation, and business intelligence.
* Strong working knowledge of our stack: Node.js, Python, React.js, OpenAI APIs, and Claude Code.
* Familiarity with a modern GTM tech stack such as Clay, HubSpot, and Sendspark.
* Hands-on expertise with AI and automation tools, prompt engineering, and building scalable workflows.
* Strong analytical skills and a data-first approach to decisions.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* A background in revenue operations, growth, or similar technical GTM roles is a strong plus.

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid experimentation.
* A data-driven decision maker with creative problem-solving ability.
* Strong business acumen with a focus on cost-effective solutions.
* Able to influence and align stakeholders across functions.
* An engineer at heart with an owner’s mindset, equally comfortable writing code and presenting to leadership.

**Location**

Delhi. This is a 100% work-from-office role.

To apply, use the link below or write to hr@castler.com.

title: Founding Technical Partner
description:
🚀
**Looking for a Founding Technical Partner | AI, EdTech & Learning Platforms to Build GrowthYari From Scratch**

We are building GrowthYari to solve a critical problem:
**the gap between education, hiring readiness and employment.**

Degrees and certificates alone don't always demonstrate whether someone can perform in a real workplace. We want to build the bridge between training institutions, candidates and employers.

**What we're building**

An
**AI-powered career-readiness and microlearning platform**
that will help candidates:

•
**Assess their Career Capital: Intellectual, Social, Brand and Inner Capital**

• Identify role-specific skill gaps through conversational assessments

• Learn through personalised, AI-enabled microlearning

•
**Build proof-of-work through practical assignments and business simulations**

• Create evidence-backed profiles that employers can evaluate

• Connect with relevant employers and hiring opportunities

**Our starting market is B.Com and BBA graduates pursuing sales, business development and other non-technical go-to-market roles.**

**Who I'm looking for**

Someone who has built and shipped real products, preferably with experience in:

✅
**EdTech, LMS or microlearning platform development**

✅ Full-stack product architecture and development from scratch

✅ AI/ML integrations, conversational AI or personalised learning systems

✅ Building assessment engines, learner dashboards or workflow-driven platforms

✅ Leading or collaborating with a team to take a product from idea to launch

✅ Making practical product decisions without overengineering an early-stage MVP

You don't need to have every skill listed, but you must be a strong builder with product judgement, ownership and a bias towards execution.

**The opportunity**

• Founder-level ownership and technical decision-making

• A product to build from zero, with room to shape its architecture and roadmap

• Prepared to invest up to
**₹10 lakh**
in product development, subject to an agreed roadmap, budget and milestones

• No fixed salary at the initial stage

• Co-founder equity and vesting to be discussed transparently and formalised through the appropriate agreements

This is
**not a conventional salaried job**
. I'm looking for someone who wants to build a company, not just complete a development assignment. The role requires a realistic time commitment and shared responsibility for outcomes.

**Interested?**

Let's build the bridge between learning and hiring readiness.
